description.zh: 记录办公软件版本、单元格类型和安全提示，确认是否真的按公式求值。
description.en: Record office application version, cell type, and security prompts to confirm actual formula evaluation.

review.rationale: 原集合是电子表格公式注入载荷，应从业务逻辑改归文件导出安全。

description.zh: 公式超链接替代命令执行。判据：受害者点击访问。
description.en: Hyperlink instead of command exec. Success: victim clicks through.

description.zh: 拼接外带单元格数据。判据：服务端收到数据。
description.en: Concatenated cell exfil. Success: data received.

description.zh: mshta 拉取 HTA 执行。判据：HTA 运行。
description.en: mshta fetches and runs the HTA. Success: HTA executes.

prerequisites.zh: 使用专用 OAuth 测试客户端、合成账户、精确登记回调和所有权明确的候选域/开放重定向端点。
prerequisites.en: Use a dedicated OAuth test client, synthetic account, exactly registered callback, and owned candidate domains or open-redirect endpoints.

prerequisites.zh: 在授权与兑换阶段关联 client_id、redirect_uri、state、一次性 code 和最终浏览器接收方，逐个改变规范化特征。
prerequisites.en: Correlate client_id, redirect_uri, state, one-time code, and final browser recipient across authorization and exchange, changing normalization features one at a time.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求未登记、解析歧义或开放重定向组合让受控外部接收方得到为测试客户端签发的 code/token，并证明凭据可在受影响绑定下兑换。外域仅收到无 code 请求、地址栏显示候选 URI、授权服务器错误页、code 被严格回调绑定而不可兑换、或导航停在登记域都不是可利用绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an unregistered, ambiguously parsed, or open-redirect-composed URI to deliver a code or token issued for the test client to the controlled external recipient, with the credential redeemable under the affected binding. An external request without a code, a candidate URI in the address bar, an authorization-server error page, a code strictly bound and unredeemable, or navigation ending at the registered domain is not an exploitable bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 一个一次性测试 code 首次离开登记回调后停止，不兑换真实用户凭据或扩展到其他客户端。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one one-time test code first leaves the registered callback; do not redeem real-user credentials or expand to other clients.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销 code/token 与会话，删除外部回调日志、页面和 DNS，清除浏览器数据并恢复精确 URI 匹配。
opsecTips.en: Revoke codes, tokens, and sessions, delete external callback logs, pages, and DNS, clear browser data, and restore exact URI matching.

name.zh: OAuth redirect_uri 校验绕过

description.zh: 验证授权服务器是否对回调地址执行预注册后的精确匹配，防止授权码或令牌被重定向到攻击者地址。
description.en: Tests whether an authorization server exactly matches redirect URIs against preregistered values so codes or tokens cannot be redirected to an attacker.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 OAuth 回调地址绑定场景，检验授权服务器对注册回调的路径穿越与斜杠变体放行。验证维度为回调路径的点段、多斜杠与编码变体矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers OAuth callback-address binding, testing authorization-server allowance of path-traversal and slash variants on registered callbacks. Validation is a callback matrix of dot segments, multi-slashes and encoded variants, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于回调匹配按字符串前缀执行或忽略路径差异：点段与多余斜杠让请求落进未注册路径仍通过校验，授权码被引导至可监听地址。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is callback matching by string prefix or with path-difference ignorance: dot segments and extra slashes land requests on unregistered paths yet pass checks, steering codes to attacker-listening addresses.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把注册回调的点段、多斜杠与编码变体逐条提交授权端点，记录 code 签发与跳转行为：任一变体仍完成签发即确认绑定不严，落地路径与注册路径的差值即为利用窗口。成功判据以签发记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit dot-segment, multi-slash and encoded variants of the registered callback to the authorization endpoint one by one per the script, recording code issuance and redirect behavior; any variant completing issuance confirms loose binding, with the gap between landing and registered paths marking the exploitation window. Judge success by issuance records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 回调校验先规范化路径再与注册值全等比对，禁止点段与多余分隔符；授权服务器拒绝解析歧义的 redirect_uri。修复后重放第 1 步矩阵，全部变体应返回错误。
mitigation.en: Normalize callback paths before full-equality comparison against registered values, banning dot segments and extra separators; the server should refuse ambiguous redirect_uris. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every variant should error.

description.zh: 从授权服务器配置确认测试客户端唯一允许的回调地址与规范化规则。
description.en: Confirm the test client's sole allowed callback and normalization rules from authorization-server configuration.

description.zh: 逐项使用原始 redirect_uri 变体发起授权，并为每次请求分配独立 state。
description.en: Initiate authorization with original redirect_uri variants one at a time and assign a distinct state to each request.

description.zh: 沿重定向链确认授权码或令牌最终到达的主机、路径与客户端身份。
description.en: Follow the redirect chain to identify the final host, path, and client identity receiving the code or token.

review.rationale: 原命令是 OAuth 回调地址规范化与匹配测试，应归入开放重定向和 OAuth 安全。

description.zh: 回调路径后接 .{攻击者域}，绕过只查前缀 https://{TARGET} 的白名单校验；成功判据：授权码被重定向到攻击者域。
description.en: Appends .attacker-host after the allowed callback path to bypass prefix-only allowlist checks. Success: the auth code is redirected to the attacker host.

description.zh: 白名单域放进 userinfo 位，真实 host 为攻击者；成功判据：跳转实际到达攻击者服务器。
description.en: Puts the allowlisted domain in userinfo while the real host is the attacker. Success: the hop actually reaches the attacker server.

description.zh: 路径段 .. 双重编码穿越回调前缀，二次解码后指向外域；成功判据：授权响应落到攻击者域。
description.en: Double-encodes the traversal to escape the callback prefix after a second decode. Success: the auth response lands on the attacker host.

prerequisites.zh: 使用两个隔离浏览器会话与合成 OAuth 身份，记录每次授权启动的服务端 state、Cookie 和回调消费状态。
prerequisites.en: Use two isolated browser sessions and synthetic OAuth identities, recording server-side state, cookies, and callback consumption for each authorization start.

prerequisites.zh: 分别测试跨会话、缺失、已消费、错误以及脚本/URL 外观的 state，保持 code、client 和 redirect_uri 合法且固定。
prerequisites.en: Test cross-session, missing, consumed, wrong, and script- or URL-looking state values separately while keeping code, client, and redirect_uri valid and fixed.

analysis.zh: 阳性是错误或来自另一浏览器会话的 state 被接受，并让当前合成浏览器建立攻击者选择的登录身份或消费授权响应。state 值看似 URL/JavaScript、被页面回显、参数解析成功、回调返回 200、错误被记录但不建立会话或合法事务完成都不是 OAuth 登录 CSRF。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is an incorrect or another browser session's state being accepted and causing the current synthetic browser to establish an attacker-selected identity or consume the authorization response. A state value looking like a URL or JavaScript, reflection, parsed parameters, HTTP 200 on callback, a logged error without session creation, or completion of the legitimate transaction is not OAuth login CSRF.

opsecTips.zh: 跨会话 state 首次改变合成登录身份后停止，不继续账户绑定、资料修改或真实用户流程。
opsecTips.en: Stop after cross-session state first changes the synthetic logged-in identity; do not continue to account linking, profile changes, or real-user flows.

opsecTips.zh: 注销两个浏览器会话，撤销 code/token，清除 state 存储与回调日志，并恢复随机、绑定和单次消费。
opsecTips.en: Revoke both browser sessions and all codes or tokens, clear state storage and callback logs, and restore randomness, binding, and single consumption.

name.zh: OAuth state 注入与类型混淆测试
name.en: OAuth state Injection and Type-Confusion Test

description.zh: 验证 OAuth state 是否随机、一次性并绑定发起授权的浏览器会话，防止登录 CSRF 与响应注入。
description.en: Tests whether OAuth state is random, single-use, and bound to the initiating browser session to prevent login CSRF and response injection.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 OAuth state 处理缺陷场景，检验 state 被当作跳转或注入载体时的服务端校验缺失。验证维度为 URL、脚本协议与类型混淆 state 的变体矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers OAuth state-handling defects, testing missing server validation when state doubles as a redirect or injection carrier. Validation is a variant matrix of URL, script-scheme and type-confused states, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 state 回传后被直接用于跳转或拼进输出且未校验原始随机值：攻击者把 state 变成开放重定向或注入通道，登录 CSRF 与钓鱼链路随之打通。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is returned state used directly for redirects or output concatenation without verifying the original random value: attackers turn state into an open redirect or injection channel, opening login-CSRF and phishing chains.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把外部 URL、脚本协议与数组对象形态的 state 逐条注入回调流程，记录跳转行为与会话绑定结果：state 引发跳转、注入或忽略校验即确认处理缺陷。成功判据以回调后的行为记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；全程使用测试会话。
exploitation.en: In step 1, inject external-URL, script-scheme and array-object state shapes into the callback flow one by one per the script, recording redirect behavior and session binding; state causing jumps, injections or skipped validation confirms the handling defect. Judge success by post-callback behavior records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use test sessions throughout.

mitigation.zh: state 仅作不透明随机值与会话绑定比对，禁止参与跳转或输出拼接，类型异常直接拒绝。修复后重放第 1 步矩阵，全部变体 state 应被拒绝且无跳转发生。
mitigation.en: Treat state as an opaque random value compared against session binding, barring redirects and output concatenation, rejecting type anomalies. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every variant state should be rejected with no redirects.

description.zh: 在隔离浏览器中分别记录 state、会话 Cookie、PKCE 与预期登录账号。
description.en: Record state, session cookie, PKCE, and expected account in two isolated browsers.

description.zh: 逐项应用原始 state 变体修改回调，保持授权码和客户端参数可追踪。
description.en: Apply original state variants one at a time to modify callbacks while keeping code and client parameters traceable.

description.zh: 检查服务端授权事务与最终会话主体，确认是否接受了另一浏览器的响应。
description.en: Inspect the server authorization transaction and final session principal to determine whether another browser's response was accepted.

review.rationale: 原集合用于 state 参数负向测试，应归入 OAuth 登录 CSRF 而非业务逻辑。

description.zh: 编码斜杠绕过明文外域检测。判据：重定向至攻击域。
description.en: Encoded slashes evade plaintext external-domain rules. Success: redirect to attacker host.

description.zh: 二次解码还原 // 前缀。判据：解码后跳转攻击域。
description.en: Second decode restores the // prefix. Success: navigates to attacker host after decoding.

description.zh: 框架将 state 解析为数组时 url 键被采用。判据：回调指向攻击域。
description.en: Framework parses state as an array honoring the url key. Success: callback points at the attacker host.

prerequisites.zh: 先逐项区分运行时失败输入与正则源码样例，把前者路由到隔离计时测试、后者路由到静态分析工具。
prerequisites.en: First distinguish runtime failing inputs from regex source examples, routing the former to isolated timing tests and the latter to static-analysis tools.

prerequisites.zh: 为每个风险 pattern 确定语言/引擎和真实调用点，并用递增长度、匹配/失败对照及资源上限验证。
prerequisites.en: Identify language, engine, and real call site for every risky pattern, validating with increasing lengths, match and failure controls, and resource limits.

analysis.zh: 本条拆分阳性要求输入和源码样例各自进入正确目标：静态工具能定位嵌套量词/歧义分支，运行时则必须呈可重复超线性增长并关联到该 pattern。字符串较长、工具仅报警、pattern 作为请求被回显、一次超时或未在应用使用的危险正则都不能证明可利用 ReDoS。
analysis.en: Positive evidence for the split requires inputs and source examples to reach the correct targets: static tooling locates nested quantifiers or ambiguous branches, while runtime testing must show reproducible superlinear growth tied to that pattern. A long string, a tool warning alone, a pattern reflected as request text, one timeout, or a risky regex unused by the application does not prove exploitable ReDoS.

opsecTips.zh: 运行时曲线达到资源阈值或静态位置已确认后停止，不把两组内容拼成批量网络请求。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the runtime curve reaches the resource threshold or the static location is confirmed; do not combine both groups into bulk network requests.

opsecTips.zh: 终止测试 worker，删除 trace、输入集和静态扫描缓存，并保留仅含脱敏 pattern 路由的拆分记录。
opsecTips.en: Terminate test workers, delete traces, input sets, and static-scan caches, and retain only a redacted pattern-routing record.

name.zh: ReDoS 输入与高风险正则混合集
name.en: Mixed ReDoS Inputs and Risky Regex Patterns

description.zh: 同时包含近似失败输入和高风险正则模式，需拆分为运行时载荷与静态正则分析资料。
description.en: Contains both near-failing inputs and risky regex patterns and should be split into runtime payloads and static regex-analysis material.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖回溯复杂度测量场景，检验处理耗时随输入长度阶梯的增长关系以定位高危正则表达式。验证维度为固定终止符与递减长度的对照输入阶梯，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers backtracking-complexity measurement, testing how processing time scales across input-length ladders to locate risky regexes. Validation is a control ladder of fixed terminators with decreasing lengths, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于业务正则包含嵌套量词或重叠可选分支：近似匹配输入触发指数级回溯，单请求即可占满处理线程，形成可复现的拒绝服务点。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is business regexes with nested quantifiers or overlapping optional branches: near-match inputs trigger exponential backtracking, letting one request saturate threads into a reproducible denial-of-service point.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本以固定终止字符构造长度递减的对照输入逐条提交并计时，绘制长度与耗时曲线：耗时呈指数级增长即确认回溯缺陷，再以二分定位最短可复现长度作为证据。成功判据以增长曲线为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；并发保持 1 并限定总请求量。
exploitation.en: In step 1, build decreasing-length control inputs with a fixed terminator per the script, submitting and timing each to chart length versus time; exponential growth confirms the backtracking defect, then bisect for the shortest reproducible length as evidence. Judge success by the growth curve. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; hold concurrency at 1 and cap total requests.

mitigation.zh: 重构高危正则消除嵌套量词并加输入长度上限，超时保护正则执行线程，监控处理耗时基线。修复后重放第 1 步，耗时增长应转为线性。
mitigation.en: Refactor risky regexes to remove nested quantifiers with input-length caps, guard regex execution with timeouts, and monitor processing-time baselines. After the fix, replay step 1: growth should turn linear.

description.zh: 根据语法将原始行分成可发送字符串和仅用于静态审查的正则表达式。
description.en: Classify original lines into sendable strings and regex expressions used only for static review.

description.zh: 只对输入组逐项执行受控匹配，设置超时并记录每个长度的独立耗时。
description.en: Execute controlled matching only for the input group, with a timeout and isolated timing per length.

attackChain.payload:
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!
aaaaaaaaaaaa!

description.zh: 将模式组导入正则分析工具，核对嵌套量词与重叠分支是否出现在生产路径。
description.en: Import the pattern group into a regex analyzer and verify whether nested quantifiers or overlapping alternatives occur in production paths.

review.rationale: 同一命令块混合运行时输入与正则源码样例，必须拆分后分别进入载荷和分析工具。

wafBypass.command: node -e "const re=/(a+)+$/; for (const n of [12,16,20,24,28,32,36]) { const t=Date.now(); re.test('\u0061'.repeat(n)+'!'); console.log(n, Date.now()-t, 'ms'); }"

description.zh: 绕过对连续字面 aaaa 阶梯串的签名：以 \u0061 转义在运行期构造同一阶梯（12→36），传输内容不含长 a 串；成功判据：耗时随长度指数增长，确认邪恶正则存在。
description.en: Bypasses signatures on literal aaaa ladder runs: the same ladder (12 to 36) is built at runtime via \u0061 escapes so no long a-run crosses the wire; success criterion: exponential timing growth confirms the evil regex.

wafBypass.command: node -e "const s='\u0061'.repeat(24)+'!'; for (const p of ['(a+)+$','(a|aa)+$','(a*)*b','(a|a?)+$','([a]+)+$']) { const t=Date.now(); new RegExp(p).test(s); console.log(p, Date.now()-t, 'ms'); }"

description.zh: 绕过只防 (a+)+ 一种量词写法的规则：(a|aa)+、(a*)*b、(a|a?)+、([a]+)+ 均为回溯等价形态，轮换测出同样灾难行为；成功判据：多数形态在同一输入上出现毫秒级以上回溯耗时。
description.en: Bypasses rules guarding only the (a+)+ shape: (a|aa)+, (a*)*b, (a|a?)+ and ([a]+)+ are backtrack-equivalent alternates exposing the same blowup; success criterion: most shapes take millisecond-plus backtracking on the same input.

description.zh: 绕过对 "a 串+!" 固定边界的输入检测：换用 ~ ^ - + _ 等非匹配字符做阶梯终止符，失配位置不变、回溯复杂度等价；成功判据：各边界变体耗时与 ! 版本同量级。
description.en: Bypasses input checks fixed on the "a-run+!" boundary: alternate non-matching terminators ~ ^ - + _ keep the mismatch point and backtracking complexity equivalent; success criterion: each boundary variant times in the same order as the ! version.

title.zh: 包裹上下文与编码边界

description.zh: 绕过对裸长字符串参数的检测：载荷藏进表单字段名 q、JSON 值与 XML 文本等应用层上下文，边界符再以 %21/%2521 编码，进入正则前由应用解码；成功判据：包裹与编码形态均触发相同回溯延迟。
description.en: Bypasses detection of bare long-string parameters: the payload hides in a form field q, JSON value or XML text, with the boundary encoded as %21/%2521 and decoded by the app before the regex; success criterion: wrapped and encoded forms trigger the same backtracking delay.

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有权威 DNS 域控制 TTL 与解析顺序，准备公网回调和隔离环回标记服务，记录每次解析/连接。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned authoritative DNS domain to control TTL and answer order, with a public callback and isolated loopback marker recording every resolution and connection.

prerequisites.zh: 确认应用在验证、重定向和连接阶段的解析器与缓存，限制出站网络只允许两个受控标记端点。
prerequisites.en: Identify resolvers and caches at validation, redirect, and connection stages, limiting egress to the two controlled marker endpoints.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求主机名在检查时解析为允许地址、连接时重新解析为受控内网/环回地址，并由服务端连接日志和标记请求证明未重新校验。DNS 答案改变、缓存命中、浏览器访问、仅收到 DNS 查询、连接仍到公网、解析失败或扫描器识别 nip.io 都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the hostname to resolve to an allowed address during validation and to a controlled internal or loopback address at connection time, with server-side connection logs and marker requests proving no revalidation. A changed DNS answer, cache hit, browser access, DNS query alone, connection still reaching public IP, resolution failure, or a scanner recognizing nip.io is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 环回标记首次收到服务端连接后停止，不指向云元数据、真实内网服务或第三方重绑定域。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the loopback marker first receives the server connection; do not target cloud metadata, real internal services, or third-party rebinding domains.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 DNS 记录，关闭回调/环回服务，刷新解析与代理缓存，撤销临时出站规则并清理请求日志。
opsecTips.en: Delete DNS records, shut down callback and loopback services, flush resolver and proxy caches, revoke temporary egress rules, and clear request logs.

name.zh: DNS 重绑定主机名测试

description.zh: 使用可变解析主机名验证应用是否在首次解析后错误信任主机，并在后续连接时访问内网地址。
description.en: Uses hostnames with changing resolution to test whether an application trusts an initial lookup and later connects to an internal address.

subCategory.zh: 地址变形与 DNS 解析绕过

overview.zh: DNS 重绑定主机名测试覆盖解析一致性场景：针对在解析后信任主机名的应用，验证可变解析主机名能否让后续连接访问内网地址。验证维度涵盖公共重绑定服务可用性核对、自有权威 DNS 交替解析与 DNS/连接日志关联三类。
overview.en: DNS Rebinding Hostname Testing covers resolution consistency: for applications trusting hostnames after a first resolution, verify whether variably resolving names steer later connections into intranets. Verification dimensions cover public rebinding-service availability checks, owned authoritative-DNS alternating resolution, and DNS/connection log correlation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用只校验第一次 DNS 结果或只比较主机名，攻击者可让后续解析指向回环或私网地址绕过 SSRF 允许列表；仅 DNS 返回不同地址而目标未建立内网连接不构成实际访问，必须以连接证据为准。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application validating only the first DNS answer or merely comparing hostnames, letting later resolutions point at loopback or private addresses to bypass SSRF allowlists; differing DNS answers without an established intranet connection are not actual access — connection evidence decides.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步在自有权威 DNS 中配置可审计、低 TTL 的测试域并建立外部地址基线；随后逐项使用原始主机名形态（1u.ms、nip.io、sslip.io、rbndr.us 等），在隔离网络让后续解析指向测试内网服务，关联 DNS 查询与连接日志，目标建立内网连接即确认重绑定窗口成立；浏览器 DNS 或未连接的解析属于误报。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 configures an auditable, low-TTL test zone on owned authoritative DNS and establishes an external-address baseline; then exercise the original hostname forms one by one (1u.ms, nip.io, sslip.io, rbndr.us, etc.), steering later resolutions to a test intranet service on an isolated network and correlating DNS queries with connection logs — the target establishing an intranet connection confirms the rebinding window; browser DNS or unconnected resolutions are false positives. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 在实际连接前解析并校验所有 A 与 AAAA 地址，阻断回环、私网和链路本地范围；固定已批准目标或使用受控出口代理，对重定向与每次重新解析重复校验并防止 DNS 缓存投毒。修复后用样例回归，后续解析变化不再改变连接目标。
mitigation.en: Resolve and validate all A and AAAA addresses before the actual connection, blocking loopback, private, and link-local ranges; pin approved targets or use a controlled egress proxy, recheck on redirects and every re-resolution, and guard against DNS cache poisoning. After the fix, regress with the samples: later resolution changes no longer move the connection target.

title.zh: 建立可控 DNS 区域

description.zh: 使用自有权威 DNS 记录每次查询，并配置外部与测试内网两个地址阶段。
description.en: Use an owned authoritative DNS service to log every query and configure external and test-internal address phases.

description.zh: 逐项使用原始主机名形式触发目标请求，保持协议、端口与路径不变。
description.en: Use original hostname forms one at a time to trigger target requests while holding scheme, port, and path constant.

description.zh: 对照 DNS 时间线与测试内网服务日志，确认实际连接使用了后续私网解析。
description.en: Compare the DNS timeline with test-internal service logs to confirm the actual connection used the later private resolution.

review.rationale: 主机名集合是 DNS 重绑定与 SSRF 地址校验测试载荷，应改归 SSRF。

description.zh: 绕过按主机名黑名单的判定：同一通配域名下用端口区分内网服务；端口响应差异可辨即成功。
description.en: Distinguish internal services by port under one wildcard hostname past hostname blacklists; distinguishable port responses confirm success.

wafBypass.command: http://rebind6.{LAB_OAST}/  # 仅 AAAA 记录: 第一次 ::ffff 外部, 第二次 内部 v6

description.zh: 绕过只审计 A 记录解析的规则：用 AAAA 记录做 IPv6 侧重绑定；两次请求源地址变化即成功。
description.en: Perform v6-side rebinding via AAAA-only records against A-record auditing; source addresses changing across requests confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过对最终内网 IP 的直接特征匹配：经 CNAME 链条间接到达内网目标；网关页面返回即成功。
description.en: Reach the internal target through a CNAME cascade against direct-IP matching; a gateway page returning confirms success.

prerequisites.zh: 在独立攻击站点和浏览器 profile 中使用合成登录账户，选择只切换无价值 canary 的敏感型按钮。
prerequisites.en: Use a separate attacker site and browser profile with a synthetic logged-in account, selecting a sensitive-shaped button that only toggles a valueless canary.

prerequisites.zh: 记录目标页 X-Frame-Options、CSP frame-ancestors、SameSite、嵌套祖先链和 iframe 实际渲染区域。
prerequisites.en: Record the target page's X-Frame-Options, CSP frame-ancestors, SameSite behavior, nested ancestor chain, and actual iframe render area.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求第三方页面成功嵌入已认证目标，透明覆盖将测试用户的一次明确点击落到预定 canary 控件并造成对应状态变化。iframe 标签存在、页面空白、浏览器控制台报阻止、只加载公开页、坐标不重合、脚本自动点击或用户看到并直接操作目标都不是点击劫持。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the third-party page to frame the authenticated target and transparently align one deliberate test-user click with the designated canary control, causing the corresponding state change. An iframe tag, blank page, browser blocking console error, public-page framing, misaligned coordinates, scripted clicks, or the user visibly operating the target is not clickjacking.

opsecTips.zh: canary 首次因对齐点击改变后停止，不对转账、删除、权限或真实账户控件进行覆盖。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the canary first changes from the aligned click; do not overlay transfer, deletion, privilege, or real-account controls.

opsecTips.zh: 回滚 canary，删除攻击页面和浏览器 profile，注销会话并恢复 frame-ancestors/XFO 与高风险操作确认。
opsecTips.en: Roll back the canary, delete the attacker page and browser profile, revoke the session, and restore frame-ancestors or XFO and confirmations for high-risk actions.

name.zh: iframe 透明度与可见性变体验证
name.en: iframe Opacity and Visibility Variant Validation

description.zh: 使用透明覆盖 iframe 验证敏感页面能否被第三方站点嵌入，并诱导用户完成非预期操作。
description.en: Uses transparent overlay iframes to test whether a sensitive page can be embedded by a third-party site and induce unintended user actions.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖透明 iframe 点击劫持场景，检验不同透明度与定位方式下敏感页面诱导点击的可行性。验证维度为全透明、半透明与局部覆盖的三类叠加样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers transparent-iframe clickjacking, testing lure-click feasibility against sensitive pages under varying opacities and positioning. Validation covers fully transparent, semi-transparent and partial-overlay samples, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于敏感页面可被嵌入且响应头防护缺失：攻击者按透明度分级叠加 iframe 对齐真实按钮，用户在诱饵语境下完成非预期操作。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is sensitive pages being embeddable with missing response-header protection: attackers layer iframes by transparency grade aligned onto real buttons, completing unintended actions inside a decoy context.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本部署三类透明度叠加页并分别对齐目标按钮，逐一点击验证操作触发与用户感知差异：低可见度帧仍完成操作即确认覆盖可行，记录各档位下的辨识度作为风险分级。成功判据以操作执行与感知对照为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；目标操作使用合成端点。
exploitation.en: In step 1, deploy the three transparency-overlay pages aligned onto target buttons per the script and click each, verifying action triggers against user perception; low-visibility frames still completing actions confirm overlay feasibility, graded by recognizability per tier. Judge success by action-execution versus perception comparison. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; target actions use synthetic endpoints.

mitigation.zh: 敏感页面统一返回 frame 防护头并对关键操作加确认层，用户界面采用 CSP frame-ancestors 精确限定。修复后重放第 1 步，三类叠加均应被浏览器拒绝加载。
mitigation.en: Serve uniform frame-protection headers on sensitive pages with confirmation layers on critical actions, precisely limiting framing via CSP frame-ancestors. After the fix, replay step 1: all three overlays should fail to load.

description.zh: 从自有测试源加载无副作用页面并记录 CSP、XFO 与控制台拦截结果。
description.en: Load a harmless page from an owned test origin and record CSP, XFO, and console enforcement results.

description.zh: 使用原始 iframe 样式把测试按钮与诱饵元素对齐，但不触发真实敏感操作。
description.en: Use original iframe styles to align a test button with a decoy element without triggering a real sensitive action.

attackChain.payload:
<iframe src="https://{TARGET}" style="opacity:0;position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:9999"></iframe>
<iframe src="https://{TARGET}" style="opacity:0;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%"></iframe>
<iframe src="https://{TARGET}" style="opacity:0.0001;position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:9999"></iframe>
<iframe src="https://{TARGET}" style="opacity:0.0001;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%"></iframe>
<iframe src="https://{TARGET}" style="visibility:hidden;position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:9999"></iframe>
<iframe src="https://{TARGET}" style="visibility:hidden;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%"></iframe>

description.zh: 采集浏览器坐标、截图和服务端测试事件，确认点击落在被嵌入页面。
description.en: Capture coordinates, screenshots, and the server-side test event to confirm the click reached the framed page.

review.rationale: 原命令是透明 iframe 点击劫持模板，应归入点击劫持类别。

description.zh: 绕过 opacity<1 阈值检测：不透明度保持 1 借混合模式在白底隐形；覆盖层点击穿透目标即成功。
description.en: Keep opacity at 1 and vanish via blend mode on a white background past low-opacity thresholds; overlay clicks reaching the target confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过全屏覆盖特征：初始离屏在指针移动时回滑到位；回滑后交互命中目标控件即成功。
description.en: Park offscreen and slide back on pointer movement past full-screen-overlay signatures; post-slide interactions hitting target controls confirm success.

description.zh: 以渲染跳过属性替代透明度隐藏：定时恢复可见后承载点击；恢复期内点击命中目标即成功。
description.en: Hide via render-skipping instead of transparency and restore on a timer; clicks during the restored window hitting the target confirm success.

prerequisites.zh: 采集实际受保护页面最终响应中的所有 X-Frame-Options/CSP Header，包含 CDN、代理和重定向后的结果。
prerequisites.en: Collect all X-Frame-Options and CSP headers from the final protected-page response, including CDN, proxy, and post-redirect results.

prerequisites.zh: 在当前受支持浏览器中从同源与跨源测试页验证 framing，并记录重复 Header、ALLOW-FROM 和 CSP 优先级。
prerequisites.en: Validate framing from same-origin and cross-origin test pages in currently supported browsers, recording duplicate headers, ALLOW-FROM, and CSP precedence.

analysis.zh: 阳性工具发现是实际受保护页面因缺失、无效或冲突的 framing 策略而在目标浏览器中被不受信任源渲染；若评估影响，再结合无害 canary 控件。目录中含 ALLOW-FROM、把字符串作为请求发送、Header 出现在文档、旧浏览器理论差异或 iframe 被阻止都不是配置漏洞。
analysis.en: Positive tool evidence is an actual protected page being rendered by an untrusted origin in a target browser because framing policy is missing, invalid, or conflicting; impact can then be paired with a harmless canary control. ALLOW-FROM appearing in the catalog, sending a value as a request, a header string in documentation, theoretical legacy-browser differences, or a blocked iframe is not a configuration flaw.

opsecTips.zh: 一个受保护测试页在受支持浏览器中被跨源渲染后停止，不继续覆盖真实敏感控件。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one protected test page is cross-origin rendered in a supported browser; do not continue to overlay real sensitive controls.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 framing fixture 和浏览器 profile，清除 CDN/代理缓存与响应捕获，并恢复 CSP frame-ancestors 与一致 XFO。
opsecTips.en: Delete framing fixtures and browser profiles, clear CDN and proxy caches and response captures, and restore CSP frame-ancestors and consistent XFO.

name.zh: X-Frame-Options 策略值审查表

description.zh: 整理遗留 X-Frame-Options 值用于响应头配置审查；这些文本不是可发送到目标的攻击载荷。
description.en: Catalogs legacy X-Frame-Options values for response-header configuration review; the text is not an attack payload to send to a target.

overview.zh: 原集合几乎全部是 ALLOW-FROM 变体，这是已废弃且浏览器支持不一致的响应头指令。正确用途是检查服务器实际返回的策略，而不是把这些值作为请求参数批量测试。
overview.en: The original set consists mainly of ALLOW-FROM variants, a deprecated directive with inconsistent browser support. Its proper use is reviewing policies actually returned by the server, not sending the values as request parameters.

vulnerability.zh: 依赖无效、重复或被中间层覆盖的 X-Frame-Options 可能使页面在部分浏览器中仍可嵌入。然而配置文本出现在源码、文档或扫描报告中，不代表生产响应缺少有效保护。
vulnerability.en: Invalid, duplicated, or intermediary-overwritten X-Frame-Options may leave pages frameable in some browsers. Configuration text in source, documentation, or scanner output does not mean production responses lack effective protection.

exploitation.zh: 1. 将原始值导入安全响应头审查规则；2. 从多个敏感路由和响应状态采集实际头部，并在支持矩阵内解释；3. 用跨源 iframe 验证最终浏览器行为。仅匹配 ALLOW-FROM 字符串、代理缓存头或非敏感页面可嵌入属于误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Import the original values into a security-header review rule. 2. Collect actual headers from multiple sensitive routes and response states and interpret them against browser support. 3. Validate final behavior with a cross-origin iframe. Matching an ALLOW-FROM string, cached proxy headers, or a frameable nonsensitive page is a false positive.

mitigation.zh: 1. 以 CSP frame-ancestors 作为主要控制并按需补充 SAMEORIGIN 或 DENY；2. 在反向代理和应用层避免重复冲突头；3. 对登录、支付和管理页面持续运行跨源嵌入浏览器测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Use CSP frame-ancestors as the primary control and add SAMEORIGIN or DENY when needed. 2. Avoid duplicate conflicting headers across proxies and applications. 3. Continuously test cross-origin framing on login, payment, and administration pages.

description.zh: 从敏感页面的成功、错误和重定向响应中记录最终 XFO 与 CSP 头部。
description.en: Record final XFO and CSP headers from successful, error, and redirect responses on sensitive pages.

description.zh: 把原始策略文本导入响应头审查工具，标记废弃、冲突与不受支持的值。
description.en: Import original policy text into a header-review tool and flag deprecated, conflicting, and unsupported values.

description.zh: 在跨源测试页嵌入目标并记录控制台与渲染结果，确认策略是否真正生效。
description.en: Frame the target from a cross-origin test page and record console and rendering results to confirm enforcement.

review.rationale: 记录是响应头策略字符串目录，不是请求载荷，应并入 HTTP 安全头审查工具。

prerequisites.zh: 获取实际页面的完整 CSP（包括 Report-Only、多个 Header、meta 与重定向），解析而不是拼接单个 directive 片段。
prerequisites.en: Obtain the actual page's complete CSP, including Report-Only, multiple headers, meta policies, and redirects, parsing rather than concatenating isolated directive fragments.

prerequisites.zh: 从受控允许源、不允许源和嵌套祖先链在真实浏览器中 framing，记录 console、CSP report 与渲染结果。
prerequisites.en: Frame the page from controlled allowed, disallowed, and nested ancestor chains in a real browser, recording console output, CSP reports, and rendering.

analysis.zh: 阳性工具发现是完整策略错误地允许攻击者可控祖先，或在嵌套链中漏检，使受保护测试页实际跨源渲染并产生对应 CSP 证据。策略文本含 evil.com、Report-Only 报告、directive 作为 URL 参数、公开页可嵌入、无凭证空页或浏览器正确阻止都不是可利用配置。
analysis.en: Positive tool evidence is the complete policy mistakenly allowing an attacker-controlled ancestor or missing one in a nested chain, causing the protected test page to render cross-origin with corresponding CSP evidence. evil.com text in a policy, a Report-Only report, a directive sent as a URL parameter, framing of a public page, an unauthenticated blank page, or correct browser blocking is not exploitable configuration.

opsecTips.zh: 首个不受信任祖先成功渲染受保护测试页后停止，不添加透明覆盖或真实操作。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first untrusted ancestor successfully renders the protected test page; do not add transparent overlays or real actions.

opsecTips.zh: 删除祖先链 fixture 和 CSP report，清除浏览器/CDN 缓存，并恢复精确 frame-ancestors 与监测配置。
opsecTips.en: Delete ancestor-chain fixtures and CSP reports, clear browser and CDN caches, and restore exact frame-ancestors and monitoring configuration.

name.zh: CSP frame-ancestors 策略审查表

description.zh: 整理 frame-ancestors 源表达式用于 CSP 配置审查，重点检查实际响应策略与浏览器祖先链匹配。
description.en: Catalogs frame-ancestors source expressions for CSP configuration review, focusing on actual response policy and browser ancestor-chain matching.

overview.zh: 原集合是 CSP 响应指令片段，其中部分值过宽或仅适合作为反例。它们不应作为 URL 参数发送；应与完整 Content-Security-Policy、多个祖先层级及报告模式结果一起审查。
overview.en: The original set contains CSP response-directive fragments, some intentionally broad or suitable only as counterexamples. They should not be sent as URL parameters and must be reviewed with the complete policy, nested ancestors, and reporting results.

vulnerability.zh: 若 frame-ancestors 缺失、语法无效、源表达式过宽或被重复策略误配置，敏感页面可能被非预期站点嵌入。仅在报告模式看到告警或在同源页面成功嵌入，不足以证明跨源绕过。
vulnerability.en: If frame-ancestors is absent, invalid, overly broad, or misconfigured across duplicate policies, a sensitive page may be framed by unintended sites. Report-only alerts or successful same-origin framing do not prove a cross-origin bypass.

exploitation.zh: 1. 抓取目标成功、错误与重定向响应的完整 CSP；2. 将原始片段导入策略审查器，检查语法、scheme、端口和通配符；3. 从允许与不允许的多层祖先页进行浏览器验证。报告模式、插件干预或缓存旧策略属于误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Capture complete CSP from successful, error, and redirect responses. 2. Import original fragments into a policy reviewer and inspect syntax, schemes, ports, and wildcards. 3. Validate from allowed and disallowed nested ancestor pages. Report-only mode, extension interference, and cached old policies are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 对敏感页面使用最小化 frame-ancestors 允许列表或 'none'；2. 在所有状态码和边缘节点统一发送强制策略；3. 对通配符、scheme、端口、多层 frame 与 Report-Only 差异建立自动化浏览器测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Use a minimal frame-ancestors allowlist or 'none' on sensitive pages. 2. Send an enforced policy consistently across status codes and edge nodes. 3. Automate browser tests for wildcards, schemes, ports, nested frames, and Report-Only differences.

title.zh: 汇总完整 CSP 策略

description.zh: 采集不同路由、状态码和边缘节点返回的全部 CSP 与报告模式头部。
description.en: Collect all enforced and report-only CSP headers across routes, status codes, and edge nodes.

description.zh: 使用原始 frame-ancestors 片段校验语法与匹配范围，不向业务接口发送。
description.en: Use original frame-ancestors fragments to validate syntax and match scope without sending them to business endpoints.

frame-ancestors http://evil.com:80

frame-ancestors http://evil.com:8443

description.zh: 从允许和拒绝的嵌套测试页面加载目标，记录浏览器实际执行与控制台报告。
description.en: Load the target from allowed and denied nested test pages and record actual browser enforcement and console reports.

review.rationale: 记录是 CSP 配置片段目录，应迁移到 HTTP 安全头工具而不是保留为独立攻击载荷。

prerequisites.zh: 定位应用脚本实际读取的全局或配置属性及后续 sink，在固定浏览器版本中记录注入前的类型和值。
prerequisites.en: Locate the global or configuration property actually read by application script and its downstream sink, recording pre-injection type and value in a pinned browser version.

prerequisites.zh: 使用唯一无网络 sentinel URL/字符串构造重复 id/name HTML，并配对唯一 ID、无 name 和显式 DOM 查询对照。
prerequisites.en: Build duplicate id and name HTML with a unique network-free sentinel URL or string, paired with unique-ID, no-name, and explicit DOM-query controls.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求命名属性规则把脚本预期的可信值替换为攻击者元素/集合，并让 sentinel 到达实际 URL、配置或控制流 canary。DOM 中存在重复 ID、window 上出现元素、HTML 被渲染、脚本读取后进行严格类型检查并拒绝、或值未进入任何 sink 都不是可利用 clobbering。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires named-property rules to replace a trusted value expected by script with an attacker element or collection and carry the sentinel into the real URL, configuration, or control-flow canary. Duplicate IDs in the DOM, an element appearing on window, rendered HTML, script rejecting the value after strict type checking, or no downstream sink is not exploitable clobbering.

opsecTips.zh: sentinel 首次到达无副作用 sink 后停止，不导航外部域、读取 Cookie 或调用敏感功能。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the sentinel first reaches a side-effect-free sink; do not navigate externally, read cookies, or invoke sensitive functionality.

opsecTips.zh: 删除注入 HTML 和浏览器 profile，清除 DOM/缓存 trace，并恢复显式查询、类型检查与可信配置初始化。
opsecTips.en: Delete injected HTML and the browser profile, clear DOM and cache traces, and restore explicit queries, type checks, and trusted configuration initialization.

name.zh: DOM Clobbering：重复 id/name
name.en: DOM Clobbering: Duplicate id and name

description.zh: 验证攻击者控制的 HTML 是否可通过重复 id/name 创建命名属性，覆盖脚本期望的 DOM 引用或配置对象。
description.en: Tests whether attacker-controlled HTML can use duplicate id/name attributes to create named properties and override DOM references or configuration objects expected by scripts.

overview.zh: 覆盖重复 id/name 的 DOM Clobbering 验证：以重复 id/name 与表单元素构造命名属性覆盖，脚本读取到的属性变为注入值即确认覆盖成立。适用于应用依赖命名属性读取配置或 URL 的场景。
overview.en: Covers DOM clobbering via duplicate id/name: building named-property overwrites with duplicate id/name and form elements, confirmed when script-read properties become injected values. Suitable when applications rely on named properties for configuration or URLs.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把 window、document 或表单命名属性当作可信配置且攻击者可注入相应元素，DOM 引用被覆盖后改变导航、资源加载或安全判断；仅创建重复元素而脚本不读取该名称时无可利用影响。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is applications trusting window, document, or form named properties as configuration while attackers inject matching elements: overwritten DOM references alter navigation, resource loading, or security decisions; duplicate elements no script reads have no exploitable impact.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以重复 id/name 与表单元素构造命名属性覆盖；脚本读取到的属性变为注入值（如 URL 指向收集域）即确认覆盖成立。先定位读取目标名称的脚本并记录未注入时的属性类型，逐项插入 id/name 结构但指向自有无害 URL，检查属性解析、调用栈与最终网络请求。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to build named-property overwrites with duplicate id/name and form elements; script-read properties becoming injected values (such as URLs pointing at your collector) confirms the overwrite. Locate scripts reading the target names and record pre-injection property types first, insert id/name structures one by one pointing at your own harmless URLs, and inspect property resolution, call stacks, and final network requests.

mitigation.zh: 不依赖全局命名属性读取配置，用显式局部变量与可信 JSON；净化不可信 HTML 并限制 id、name、form 与 URL 属性；以类型检查、对象冻结与 DOM Clobbering 回归保护关键读取点。
mitigation.en: Never read configuration via global named properties — use explicit local variables and trusted JSON; sanitize untrusted HTML restricting id, name, form, and URL attributes; protect critical read points with type checks, object freezing, and DOM-clobbering regressions.

description.zh: 从脚本中确认被读取的全局、表单或集合属性以及期望的数据类型。
description.en: Identify the global, form, or collection property read by script and its expected data type.

title.zh: 插入重复 id/name 结构

description.zh: 逐项使用原始 HTML 结构指向自有无害地址，并保持其他页面内容不变。
description.en: Use original HTML structures one at a time with an owned harmless destination while holding page content constant.

title.en: Confirm script consumption of the clobbered value

description.zh: 通过断点和调用栈证明业务脚本读取了命名元素，并产生可观察行为变化。
description.en: Use breakpoints and stack traces to prove application script read the named element and produced an observable behavior change.

review.rationale: 原命令是典型 DOM Clobbering HTML 结构，应归入 XSS/DOM 安全。

description.zh: 绕过 a 标签过滤：表单组合生成 x.y。判据：x.y 求值为 input 元素。
description.en: form/input builds x.y when a tags are filtered. Success: x.y is an input.

title.zh: 重复 name 集合覆盖

description.zh: 两个 name 生成 window.x 集合。判据：window.x 为集合且含 y。
description.en: Two names produce a collection. Success: window.x contains y.

description.zh: 单标签同时暴露 id 与 name。判据：x.y 可达。
description.en: One anchor exposing both. Success: x.y reachable.

description.zh: iframe 的 name 直接覆盖 window.x。判据：window.x 指向 frame。
description.en: iframe name clobbers the global directly. Success: window.x is the frame.

prerequisites.zh: 从源码确认应用自定义的 document 属性读取，区分浏览器只读内建属性，并固定浏览器及 DOM 解析模式。
prerequisites.en: Confirm application-defined document property reads from source, distinguish browser read-only built-ins, and pin browser and DOM parsing mode.

prerequisites.zh: 为每个候选名称记录属性描述符与解析前后值，使用无网络 sentinel 和不会形成命名属性的元素对照。
prerequisites.en: Record property descriptors and values before and after parsing each candidate name, using a network-free sentinel and an element that does not form a named property as control.

analysis.zh: 阳性是命名元素覆盖或创建了应用实际读取的 document 配置属性，并使 sentinel 改变一个固定 canary 分支或安全 URL sink。尝试覆盖 cookie/location 等只读内建但值未变、元素可由 document.getElementById 找到、属性只存在于集合、浏览器差异无实际脚本读取都属于假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a named element overriding or creating a document configuration property actually read by the application and causing the sentinel to change a fixed canary branch or safe URL sink. Attempts against read-only built-ins such as cookie or location with no value change, normal getElementById access, a property only in a collection, or browser differences without an application read are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 一个应用自定义属性首次驱动 canary 后停止，不测试浏览器安全内建或真实导航。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one application-defined property first drives the canary; do not test browser security built-ins or real navigation.

opsecTips.zh: 移除命名元素，删除浏览器 profile 和属性 trace，清空页面缓存，并恢复局部常量和显式 DOM 引用。
opsecTips.en: Remove named elements, delete browser profiles and property traces, clear page caches, and restore local constants and explicit DOM references.

name.zh: DOM Clobbering：document 属性覆盖

description.zh: 验证命名元素是否能干扰应用从 document 读取的属性或自定义配置，并导致 URL 或逻辑分支被替换。
description.en: Tests whether named elements can interfere with properties or custom configuration read from document and replace URLs or control-flow values.

overview.zh: 覆盖 document 命名属性污染验证：以 a[id] 覆盖 document 各命名属性（cookie、domain、location、URL、referrer 等），脚本读取属性得到注入值即确认污染成立。
overview.en: Covers document named-property pollution verification: a[id] elements overwriting document named properties (cookie, domain, location, URL, referrer, and alike), confirmed when script reads return injected values instead of native ones.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用通过 document 命名属性获取配置且未验证类型，注入元素取代预期值并控制后续导航或资源地址；现代浏览器对内建只读属性处理不一致，须以应用实际读取的自定义名称为准。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is applications fetching configuration through document named properties without type validation, letting injected elements replace expected values and steer later navigation or resource addresses; modern browsers treat built-in read-only properties inconsistently, so only custom names the app actually reads count.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 a[id] 覆盖 document 各命名属性；脚本读取属性得到注入值而非原生值即确认 document 属性可被污染。先在目标浏览器记录 document 相关属性描述符与应用读取堆栈，逐项插入元素且 href 仅指向本地测试端点，观察属性类型、分支与最终请求。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to overwrite document named properties with a[id] elements; script reads returning injected values instead of natives confirm document property pollution. Record document property descriptors and application read stacks in the target browser first, insert elements one by one with hrefs pointing only at local test endpoints, and observe property types, branches, and final requests.

mitigation.zh: 从模块私有配置对象读取值，不把 document 命名属性作为信任边界；对 HTML 输入严格净化并禁止危险 id/name；使用 URL 前执行类型与来源校验，覆盖主流浏览器回归。
mitigation.en: Read values from module-private config objects rather than trusting document named properties; strictly sanitize HTML input forbidding hazardous id/name; validate types and origins before using URLs, with regressions across major browsers.

title.zh: 记录 document 属性描述符

description.zh: 在未注入页面采集目标属性的类型、所有权、可写性与脚本读取位置。
description.en: Capture type, ownership, writability, and script read location for target properties on a clean page.

description.zh: 逐项使用原始 document 名称结构并指向本地测试地址，避免任何外部请求。
description.en: Use original document-name structures one at a time and point them to a local test address, avoiding external requests.

prerequisites.zh: 枚举应用定义而非浏览器内建的 window 全局变量，记录属性 descriptor、初始化时序和实际消费脚本。
prerequisites.en: Enumerate application-defined rather than browser-built-in window globals, recording property descriptors, initialization order, and consuming scripts.

prerequisites.zh: 使用带唯一 sentinel 的 id/name 元素，在隔离页面对比注入前、DOM 解析后和应用初始化后的类型和值。
prerequisites.en: Use id or name elements with a unique sentinel in an isolated page, comparing type and value before injection, after DOM parsing, and after application initialization.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求元素创建的 window 命名属性抢占应用预期全局，且消费脚本将其当作可信配置并触发无副作用 canary。`window`、`top` 等不可配置内建保持不变、全局仅在 console 可见、应用随后覆盖正确值、类型校验失败或没有消费路径都不是可利用污染。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an element-created window named property to preempt an application global and be consumed as trusted configuration, triggering a side-effect-free canary. Nonconfigurable built-ins such as window or top remaining unchanged, a global visible only in console, later correct initialization, failed type checks, or no consumer path is not exploitable pollution.

opsecTips.zh: 一个自定义全局首次被 clobber 并到达 canary 后停止，不测试认证、支付或外部脚本加载配置。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one custom global is first clobbered and reaches the canary; do not test authentication, payment, or external-script-loading configuration.

opsecTips.zh: 删除注入 DOM 和浏览器 profile，清理全局快照/缓存，并恢复模块作用域、显式初始化和类型断言。
opsecTips.en: Delete injected DOM and browser profiles, clear global snapshots and caches, and restore module scope, explicit initialization, and type assertions.

name.zh: DOM Clobbering：window 全局属性覆盖
name.en: DOM Clobbering: window Global Property Override

description.zh: 验证带 id/name 的元素是否创建 window 命名属性，并覆盖应用脚本依赖的全局配置或对象引用。
description.en: Tests whether elements with id/name create window named properties and override global configuration or object references used by application scripts.

overview.zh: 覆盖 window 全局属性污染验证：以 a[id] 覆盖 window 全局属性，脚本读取属性得到注入值即确认污染成立并逐条记录可覆盖清单。适用于脚本初始化前读取未定义全局配置的场景。
overview.en: Covers window global-property pollution verification: a[id] elements overwriting window globals, confirmed when script reads return injected values, with an itemized list of overwritable properties. Suitable when scripts read undefined global configs before initialization.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是脚本在初始化前从 window 读取尚未定义的全局配置，浏览器命名属性让攻击者元素占据该名称并把 href 或子属性送入危险接收点；内建属性不可覆盖或后续代码重新赋值时无实际影响。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is scripts reading yet-undefined global configs from window before initialization: browser named properties let attacker elements take the name and feed href or sub-properties into hazardous sinks; non-overwritable built-ins or later reassignment leaves no real impact.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 a[id] 覆盖 window 全局属性；脚本读取属性得到注入值即确认 window 命名属性可被污染，逐条记录可覆盖属性清单。选择应用真实读取且初始未定义的全局名并记录脚本执行顺序，逐项插入结构并使用本地无害 URL，通过断点确认值进入具体接收点。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to overwrite window globals with a[id] elements; script reads returning injected values confirm window named-property pollution, with an itemized list of overwritable properties. Choose global names the app truly reads that start undefined, record script execution order, insert structures one by one with local harmless URLs, and use breakpoints to confirm values reach specific sinks.

mitigation.zh: 在模块作用域显式初始化配置并避免隐式全局变量；对所有动态 HTML 使用可靠净化器并限制命名属性；对关键全局值做类型、来源与 URL 校验，配合 CSP 与 Trusted Types 限制危险接收点。
mitigation.en: Initialize configuration explicitly in module scope avoiding implicit globals; apply reliable sanitizers to all dynamic HTML restricting named attributes; validate types, origins, and URLs for critical global values, with CSP and Trusted Types gating hazardous sinks.

description.zh: 确认应用脚本在初始化前读取该名称，且浏览器未定义不可配置的内建属性。
description.en: Confirm application script reads the name before initialization and the browser has no nonconfigurable built-in.

description.zh: 逐项使用原始元素结构创建同名属性，并让地址指向本地无害资源。
description.en: Use original element structures one at a time to create the named property with a local harmless resource.

prerequisites.zh: 限定到自有测试 API 的明确 base URL、路径和参数位置，配置低速率、认证主体和 SPA fallback 基线。
prerequisites.en: Scope an owned test API to an explicit base URL, path, and parameter location, configuring low rate, a test principal, and an SPA-fallback baseline.

prerequisites.zh: 将版本/操作词、格式名和归档扩展分组，每次只测试一个候选并记录状态、Content-Type、schema 与后端路由。
prerequisites.en: Group version and operation words, format names, and archive extensions, testing one candidate at a time while recording status, Content-Type, schema, and backend route.

analysis.zh: 阳性工具发现是候选对应真实 API 路由或参数，返回可解析且与随机路径/参数显著不同的结构，并由网关/路由日志确认；漏洞还需另行验证授权或敏感数据。HTTP 200 的 SPA 页面、统一 404、静态文档、关键字出现在响应、重定向、空文件或 WAF 差异都不是 API 漏洞。
analysis.en: Positive tool evidence is a candidate mapping to a real API route or parameter, returning a parseable structure distinct from random controls and confirmed by gateway or router logs; a vulnerability still requires separate authorization or sensitivity proof. An SPA page with HTTP 200, uniform 404, static documentation, a keyword in the response, redirect, empty file, or WAF differential is not an API flaw.

opsecTips.zh: 首次确认一个真实路由或参数后停止该分组，不批量遍历扩展名或调用写操作。
opsecTips.en: Stop that group after confirming one real route or parameter; do not enumerate extensions in bulk or invoke write operations.

opsecTips.zh: 删除发现 fixture 和捕获响应，清理网关速率/缓存与测试日志，并撤销临时 API 凭据。
opsecTips.en: Delete discovery fixtures and captured responses, clear gateway rate state, caches, and test logs, and revoke temporary API credentials.

name.zh: API 参数与格式关键词目录
name.en: API Parameter and Format Keyword Catalog

description.zh: 汇总 API 版本、操作、数据格式和归档扩展名关键词，适合作为发现工具字典而不是独立漏洞载荷。
description.en: Catalogs API version, operation, data-format, and archive-extension keywords for discovery tools rather than as a standalone vulnerability payload.

overview.zh: 原集合混合参数名、版本片段、GraphQL 操作词、文档格式和压缩扩展名，缺少具体请求位置。它的合理用途是经过作用域约束的内容发现与参数枚举，而不是声称存在 API 漏洞。
overview.en: The original set mixes parameter names, version fragments, GraphQL operation terms, document formats, and archive extensions without a request location. Its proper use is scoped content discovery and parameter enumeration, not proof of an API vulnerability.

vulnerability.zh: 关键词本身没有漏洞属性；只有发现的端点或参数缺少认证、授权、输入验证或敏感数据保护时才形成问题。返回 200 的统一页面、前端路由回退和静态文档都可能造成假阳性。
vulnerability.en: Keywords are not vulnerabilities; a finding exists only when a discovered endpoint or parameter lacks authentication, authorization, validation, or data protection. Generic 200 pages, client-route fallbacks, and static documentation commonly create false positives.

exploitation.zh: 1. 将原始词条按参数、路径和扩展名拆分并导入发现工具；2. 仅对授权基础 URL 低速请求，记录状态、类型、长度和重定向；3. 对候选端点使用正常与未授权身份复核。统一响应、WAF 模板和静态资源不应算作 API 暴露证据。
exploitation.en: 1. Split original terms into parameter, path, and extension lists and import them into a discovery tool. 2. Request only authorized base URLs slowly, recording status, type, length, and redirects. 3. Recheck candidate endpoints with normal and unauthorized identities. Generic responses, WAF templates, and static assets are not API exposure evidence.

mitigation.zh: 1. 从生产部署移除未使用的端点、调试路由和构建产物；2. 对所有 API 版本执行一致的认证授权与 schema 校验；3. 维护接口清单、弃用流程和内容发现回归扫描，并对异常枚举限速。
mitigation.en: 1. Remove unused endpoints, debug routes, and build artifacts from production. 2. Apply consistent authentication, authorization, and schema validation to every API version. 3. Maintain an inventory and retirement process, run discovery regression scans, and rate-limit enumeration.

description.zh: 将原始行拆分为路径、参数、操作和文件扩展名列表，避免混合请求。
description.en: Separate original lines into path, parameter, operation, and file-extension lists to avoid mixed requests.

description.en: Load the original catalog into an enumeration tool configured with an authorized base URL and rate cap.

prerequisites.zh: 签发短时效、单次使用的合成重置 token 并放入测试重置页 URL，控制所有第三方资源和导航接收端。
prerequisites.en: Issue a short-lived, single-use synthetic reset token in a test reset-page URL, controlling every third-party resource and navigation recipient.

prerequisites.zh: 在真实浏览器中固定 Referrer-Policy，记录接收端原始 Referer、token 完整性和 reset canary 可用性。
prerequisites.en: Pin Referrer-Policy in a real browser and record the recipient's raw Referer, token completeness, and reset-canary usability.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求不受信任接收端实际获得完整合成重置 token，并能在有效期内进入对应账户的无副作用 reset canary。语料中的 Referer 只指向 evil 路径但没有 token、浏览器只发送 origin、日志脱敏、token 无效/已用、同源资源接收或仅地址栏含 token 都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an untrusted recipient to obtain the complete synthetic reset token and reach the corresponding account's side-effect-free reset canary within its lifetime. Corpus Referer values pointing to an evil path without a token, origin-only browser referrers, redacted logs, invalid or consumed tokens, same-origin recipients, or a token only in the address bar are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 一个受控接收端首次获得可用 token 后停止，不提交密码变更或转发给其他域。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one controlled recipient first obtains the usable token; do not submit a password change or forward it to another domain.

opsecTips.zh: 立即撤销 token，删除接收日志、页面与浏览器历史/缓存，并恢复严格 Referrer-Policy 和 URL token 禁止。
opsecTips.en: Immediately revoke the token, delete recipient logs and pages and browser history or caches, and restore a strict Referrer-Policy and prohibition on URL tokens.

name.zh: 密码重置令牌 Referer 泄露
name.en: Password Reset Token Leakage through Referer

description.zh: 验证重置页面中的令牌是否因外部资源或跳转进入 Referer，从而泄露到第三方服务日志。
description.en: Tests whether a token in a password-reset page leaks through Referer to third-party resource or navigation logs.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖重置令牌传输泄露场景，检验重置页面令牌经外部引用进入第三方服务日志的路径。验证维度为外部域引用与多类外发路径的泄露对照，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers reset-token transport leakage, testing paths by which reset-page tokens reach third-party service logs via external references. Validation contrasts external references and multiple outbound paths, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于重置链接令牌位于 URL 而页面允许外发引用：跳转或加载第三方资源时完整链接进入 Referer，一次性令牌在消费前即被记录。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is reset-link tokens living in URLs while pages allow outbound references: on jumps or third-party loads the full link enters Referer, logging the one-time token before consumption.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步在外部测试域部署引用收集端点，把携带重置令牌的页面经由跳转、外链与子资源三类路径引出，检查收集记录中的完整链接：令牌出现即确认泄露链成立。成功判据以收集端点日志为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, deploy a reference-collection endpoint on an external test domain and route the token-carrying page out via jumps, outbound links and subresources, checking collection records for full links; a token appearing completes the leak chain. Judge success by collection-endpoint logs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 重置页面设置 Referrer-Policy 为 no-referrer 并杜绝外部资源引用，令牌改经 POST 表单提交。修复后重放第 1 步，收集端点应无任何含令牌的引用。
mitigation.en: Set Referrer-Policy no-referrer on reset pages and eliminate external references, moving tokens to POST-form submission. After the fix, replay step 1: the collection endpoint should see no token-bearing references.

description.zh: 为隔离账号生成一次性令牌，记录有效期、用途和服务端事务标识。

prerequisites.zh: 为多个合成账户通过隔离通知通道签发重置 token，记录生成、绑定、过期、消费和在线尝试限制。
prerequisites.en: Issue reset tokens for multiple synthetic accounts through an isolated notification channel, recording generation, binding, expiry, consumption, and online attempt limits.

prerequisites.zh: 将短数字、常见词、空值和类型边界分别测试，使用随机基线与无密码变更 canary，避免混合解析和熵结论。
prerequisites.en: Test short numbers, common words, empty values, and type boundaries separately, using a random baseline and no-password-change canary to avoid mixing parser and entropy conclusions.

analysis.zh: 阳性是未见弱候选显著优于随机地预测有效 token，或空值/类型混淆映射到合成重置事务，并进入正确账户 canary；跨账户、过期或已消费后仍可用也成立。值短/常见、一次 fixture 猜中、错误信息不同、缺少限速、解析报错或 token 被拒绝均不证明弱 token。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is an unseen weak candidate predicting a valid token significantly better than random, or an empty or type-confused value mapping to a synthetic reset transaction and reaching the correct account canary; cross-account, expired, or post-consumption use also qualifies. A short or common value, one fixture guess, different errors, absent rate limiting, parse errors, or token rejection does not prove a weak token.

opsecTips.zh: 一个预测或边界值首次进入 reset canary 后停止，不提交新密码或扩大在线尝试。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one predicted or boundary value first reaches the reset canary; do not submit a new password or increase online attempts.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销所有重置 token，清空通知队列和样本，删除合成账户并恢复 CSPRNG、严格类型、绑定和单次使用。
opsecTips.en: Revoke all reset tokens, clear notification queues and samples, delete synthetic accounts, and restore CSPRNG generation, strict typing, binding, and single use.

name.zh: 弱密码重置令牌验证

description.zh: 使用低熵和边界令牌候选检查重置流程是否生成不可预测、一次性且与账号绑定的凭据。
description.en: Uses low-entropy and boundary token candidates to test whether password-reset credentials are unpredictable, single-use, and account-bound.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖弱密码重置令牌验证场景，检验低熵与常见值令牌能否顺利进入重置流程。验证维度为短值、顺序与常见词候选的批量提交及接受度矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers weak password-reset tokens, testing whether low-entropy and common-value tokens enter the reset flow. Validation is a batch submission and acceptance matrix of short, sequential and common-word candidates, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于重置令牌生成熵不足或服务端接受弱值：常见与顺序候选命中有效令牌即可重置任意目标，尝试限制缺失进一步放大攻击效率。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is insufficient token-generation entropy or server acceptance of weak values: common and sequential candidates hitting valid tokens reset arbitrary targets, amplified by missing attempt limits.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把弱值候选逐条提交重置确认端点并携带 dry_run 类标记，记录接受情况：任一候选进入流程即确认可猜测性，统计命中与失败分布评估搜索空间。成功判据以候选接受矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅使用测试账号并事后复位。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit weak-value candidates to the reset-confirm endpoint one by one with dry-run-style flags per the script, recording acceptances; any candidate entering the flow confirms guessability, tallying hit and failure distributions to bound the search space. Judge success by the candidate-acceptance matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use test accounts only and reset afterwards.

mitigation.zh: 重置令牌以 CSPRNG 生成高熵值并限时单次，连续失败锁定账号与来源。修复后重放第 1 步，弱候选命中应为零且批量请求被锁定。
mitigation.en: Generate high-entropy reset tokens with a CSPRNG, time-limited and single-use, locking accounts and sources on consecutive failures. After the fix, replay step 1: weak-candidate hits should be zero with batches locked out.

description.zh: 为两个隔离账号分别生成有效、已用和过期令牌，并记录事务所有者。
description.en: Generate valid, used, and expired tokens for two isolated accounts and record transaction ownership.

description.zh: 逐项使用原始 token 值请求验证接口，保持账号参数与客户端环境一致。
description.en: Request the validation endpoint with original token values one at a time while holding account parameters and client context constant.

description.en: Verify token, account, and purpose in server-side records rather than drawing conclusions from page text.

description.zh: 弱词加年份的常见弱令牌形态批量验证。成功判据：任一值通过重置校验。
description.en: Weak words combined with years as common weak-token forms. Success: any value passes reset validation.

description.en: Phone-number-seeded weak token probing. Success: any form is accepted.

description.en: Repeated-digit forms bypass length-only validation. Success: any repeated-digit value passes.

prerequisites.zh: 限定到自有 Web 根并建立随机不存在路径、SPA fallback 和公开文档样例基线，以低速逐个检查候选。
prerequisites.en: Scope an owned web root and establish random-nonexistent, SPA-fallback, and public-document baselines, checking candidates individually at low rate.

prerequisites.zh: 准备解析器识别 package/lock/npmrc 格式，并定义依赖版本、脚本、私有 registry 和 token 的脱敏规则。
prerequisites.en: Prepare parsers for package, lock, and npmrc formats and define redaction rules for dependency versions, scripts, private registries, and tokens.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求目标路径返回真实、可解析的 Node.js manifest/配置字节且来自部署环境；敏感影响需存在内部依赖、脚本、私有 registry 或凭据。HTTP 200 的 SPA fallback、目录重定向、空响应、公开示例、HTML 错误页、文件名出现在索引或正常公开客户端 package.json 都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target path to return authentic, parseable Node.js manifest or configuration bytes from the deployed environment; sensitive impact additionally requires internal dependencies, scripts, private registries, or credentials. An SPA fallback with HTTP 200, directory redirect, empty response, public sample, HTML error page, filename in an index, or intentionally public client package.json is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 首次确认一个真实 manifest 后停止，不递归请求 node_modules 或下载完整项目树。
opsecTips.en: Stop after confirming one authentic manifest; do not recursively request node_modules or download the project tree.

opsecTips.zh: 删除响应副本和解析缓存，清理访问日志中的测试令牌，撤销临时凭据并从 Web 根移除暴露文件。
opsecTips.en: Delete response copies and parser caches, clear test tokens from access logs, revoke temporary credentials, and remove exposed files from the web root.

name.zh: Node.js 依赖与包管理文件探测
name.en: Node.js Dependency and Package-Manager File Discovery

description.zh: 检查 package.json、锁文件和包管理配置是否被 Web 根目录意外公开并泄露依赖或私有仓库信息。
description.en: Checks whether package.json, lockfiles, and package-manager configuration are accidentally exposed under the web root and reveal dependencies or private registries.

overview.zh: Node.js 依赖与包管理文件探测针对 package.json、锁文件与包管理配置被 Web 根目录意外公开的场景。验证四类路径的可达性与内容格式，评估依赖与私有仓库信息泄露。
overview.en: Node.js dependency and package-manager file discovery targets package.json, lockfiles, and package-manager configuration unexpectedly exposed under the web root. It validates reachability and content format across the four path classes to assess dependency and private-registry leakage.

vulnerability.zh: 若构建产物错误包含 package.json、锁文件或 .npmrc，攻击者可获取精确依赖图、内部包名或凭证配置，扩大供应链与已知漏洞攻击面；只返回前端路由 HTML 或空目录页不构成文件泄露。
vulnerability.en: When build artifacts wrongly include package.json, lockfiles, or .npmrc, attackers obtain exact dependency graphs, internal package names, or credential configuration, widening supply-chain and known-vulnerability attack surface; responses returning SPA-route HTML or empty directory pages are not file disclosure.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步对 package.json、package-lock.json、yarn.lock、.npmrc 逐条发起请求；命中判据为路径返回 200 且内容为对应清单 JSON/YAML（.npmrc 含 registry 或令牌行）。记录每个文件的暴露状态与敏感字段（依赖版本、私有 registry、令牌占位）；对照随机路径排除软 404，区分真实文件与 SPA 路由回退。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, request package.json, package-lock.json, yarn.lock, and .npmrc one by one; a hit is 200 responses whose content is the corresponding manifest JSON/YAML (.npmrc containing registry or token lines). Record exposure status and sensitive fields per file (dependency versions, private registries, token placeholders); contrast random paths to exclude soft 404s, separating real files from SPA-route fallbacks.

mitigation.zh: 仅部署编译后的必要静态产物并从 Web 根排除清单、锁文件和配置；在 CI 中扫描发布包与镜像层；将仓库令牌放入密钥存储并轮换任何曾暴露的凭证。修复后重放第 1 步路径，确认全部不可读且业务静态资源可用。
mitigation.en: Deploy only compiled static essentials and exclude manifests, lockfiles, and configuration from the web root; scan release packages and image layers in CI; keep repository tokens in secret storage and rotate any previously exposed credentials. After the fix, replay the step-1 paths and confirm all are unreadable while business static assets work.

description.zh: 请求随机不可存在路径，记录路由回退页面的状态、类型、长度与正文哈希。
description.en: Request a random nonexistent path and record the fallback page's status, type, length, and body hash.

description.zh: 逐项使用原始文件名访问授权站点，先检查响应头再读取小型文本文件。
description.en: Use original filenames one at a time against the authorized site, checking headers before reading small text files.

prerequisites.zh: 在自有测试站点以固定 base path 和低速率请求候选，记录 SPA fallback、反向代理错误和静态资源规则。
prerequisites.en: Request candidates at a fixed base path and low rate on an owned test site, recording SPA fallbacks, reverse-proxy errors, and static-resource rules.

prerequisites.zh: 使用对应解析器验证 requirements、Pipfile、Poetry、Conda 和 setup 格式，并预设私有索引/本地路径脱敏。
prerequisites.en: Validate requirements, Pipfile, Poetry, Conda, and setup formats with appropriate parsers, predefining redaction for private indexes and local paths.

analysis.zh: 阳性是服务器公开返回可解析且与部署环境一致的 Python 依赖/环境清单；影响证据是精确版本、私有索引、editable 路径或内部包等非预期信息。文件名命中、统一 200 页面、文档示例、空文件、下载提示无正文、robots 条目或公开开源仓库镜像均不是部署泄露。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the server publicly returning a parseable Python dependency or environment manifest consistent with the deployment; impact evidence is unintended exact versions, private indexes, editable paths, or internal packages. A filename hit, uniform HTTP 200 page, documentation sample, empty file, download prompt without body, robots entry, or public open-source mirror is not deployment exposure.

opsecTips.zh: 一个真实依赖文件被确认后停止，不继续探测虚拟环境、源码目录或私有索引。
opsecTips.en: Stop after confirming one authentic dependency file; do not continue to virtual environments, source directories, or private indexes.

opsecTips.zh: 删除下载与解析结果，清理缓存/访问日志并撤销暴露的测试索引 token，再收紧静态文件白名单。
opsecTips.en: Delete downloads and parse results, clear caches and access logs, revoke exposed test-index tokens, and tighten the static-file allowlist.

name.zh: Python 依赖与环境文件探测
name.en: Python Dependency and Environment File Discovery

description.zh: 检查 requirements、Pipfile、pyproject 与环境清单是否被公开，从而泄露 Python 依赖和部署信息。
description.en: Checks whether requirements, Pipfile, pyproject, and environment manifests are public and disclose Python dependencies or deployment details.

overview.zh: Python 依赖与环境文件探测针对 requirements、Pipfile、pyproject 与环境清单被公开的场景：可泄露 Python 依赖和部署信息。验证四类清单文件的可达性与内容语法。
overview.en: Python dependency and environment file discovery targets requirements, Pipfile, pyproject, and environment manifests being exposed, leaking Python dependencies and deployment details. It validates reachability and content syntax across the four manifest classes.

vulnerability.zh: 公开 Python 依赖清单可暴露精确版本、内部包、开发路径和私有源配置，为组件漏洞与依赖混淆提供信息；仅文件名匹配、搜索引擎缓存或返回应用首页时，不应报告真实文件暴露。
vulnerability.en: Exposed Python dependency manifests reveal exact versions, internal packages, development paths, and private-source configuration, informing component vulnerabilities and dependency confusion; filename matches alone, search-engine caches, or responses returning the app homepage must not be reported as real file exposure.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步对 requirements.txt、requirements.in、Pipfile、Pipfile.lock 逐条发起请求；命中判据为路径返回 200 且内容为依赖清单语法（pip 行、TOML 段、JSON 锁结构）。记录每个文件的暴露状态与敏感字段（内部包名、私有索引 URL、可编辑安装路径）；对照随机路径排除软 404，验证响应内容符合对应语法而非错误页。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, request requirements.txt, requirements.in, Pipfile, and Pipfile.lock one by one; a hit is 200 responses whose content follows the manifest syntax (pip lines, TOML sections, JSON lock structures). Record exposure status and sensitive fields per file (internal package names, private index URLs, editable install paths); contrast random paths to exclude soft 404s, verifying content matches the expected syntax rather than error pages.

mitigation.zh: 通过构建阶段只复制运行所需产物，不把源码根目录作为静态目录；从发布包排除依赖清单与开发配置，必要公开时移除私有源；使用 SBOM 和内部资产清单替代生产文件暴露。修复后重放第 1 步路径，确认全部不可读。
mitigation.en: Copy only runtime-essential artifacts at the build stage and never serve the source root as a static directory; exclude dependency manifests and development configuration from releases, removing private sources when exposure is unavoidable; replace production file exposure with SBOMs and internal asset inventories. After the fix, replay the step-1 paths and confirm all are unreadable.

description.zh: 采集随机路径、目录路径和不存在扩展名的响应，建立误报对照。
description.en: Collect responses for random paths, directories, and nonexistent extensions to establish false-positive controls.

description.zh: 逐项请求原始 requirements、Pipfile、Poetry 与 Conda 文件名并限制大小。
description.en: Request original requirements, Pipfile, Poetry, and Conda filenames one at a time with a size cap.

description.en: Check dependency constraints, sections, and lockfile keys to confirm the response is not HTML fallback or unrelated text.

review.rationale: 原命令是 Python 依赖文件路径字典，应归入信息收集。

prerequisites.zh: 在授权 Web 根按固定路径低速检查 Composer 候选，并建立 PHP 正常执行空响应、404 和 SPA fallback 对照。
prerequisites.en: Check Composer candidates at fixed paths and low rate on an authorized web root, establishing controls for normally executed empty PHP responses, HTTP 404, and SPA fallback.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 JSON/lockfile 解析和 PHP 源码特征确认真实性，预先定义包版本、内部仓库、绝对路径与 token 脱敏。
prerequisites.en: Confirm authenticity with JSON or lockfile parsing and PHP source signatures, predefining redaction for package versions, internal repositories, absolute paths, and tokens.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求 composer.json/lock 以可解析原文公开，或 autoload.php 源码而非执行结果被返回，并包含部署相关信息。autoload.php 正常执行后的空白、统一 200 错误页、下载重定向、公开开源 manifest、文件名回显、解析失败或只有通用 Composer 文本都不是文件泄露。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires composer.json or composer.lock to be publicly returned as parseable source, or autoload.php source rather than execution output to be disclosed, with deployment-related information. Blank output from normal autoload.php execution, a uniform HTTP 200 error page, download redirect, public open-source manifest, reflected filename, parse failure, or generic Composer text is not file exposure.

opsecTips.zh: 首次确认一个真实 Composer 文件后停止，不追踪 vendor 路径或请求其他 PHP 源码。
opsecTips.en: Stop after confirming one authentic Composer file; do not follow vendor paths or request additional PHP source.

opsecTips.zh: 删除响应和解析缓存，清理访问日志，撤销泄露的测试仓库凭据，并从 Web 根移除 manifest/源码。
opsecTips.en: Delete responses and parser caches, clear access logs, revoke exposed test-repository credentials, and remove manifests or source from the web root.

name.zh: PHP Composer 清单与自动加载文件探测
name.en: PHP Composer Manifest and Autoloader Discovery

description.zh: 检查 composer.json、composer.lock 或 autoload.php 是否被公开并泄露 PHP 包、路径或自动加载结构。
description.en: Checks whether composer.json, composer.lock, or autoload.php is public and discloses PHP packages, paths, or autoload structure.

overview.zh: PHP Composer 清单与自动加载文件探测针对 composer.json、composer.lock 或 autoload.php 被公开的场景：可泄露 PHP 包、路径或自动加载结构。验证三类文件的可达性与内容形态。
overview.en: PHP Composer manifest and autoloader discovery targets composer.json, composer.lock, or autoload.php being exposed, leaking PHP packages, paths, or autoload structure. It validates reachability and content forms across the three file classes.

vulnerability.zh: Web 根目录公开 Composer 清单可能暴露精确包版本和私有仓库，源码形式返回自动加载文件还会泄露目录结构；文件存在但由 PHP 正常执行、响应为空且无内容泄露时，影响不能按源码暴露计算。
vulnerability.en: Composer manifests exposed under the web root reveal exact package versions and private repositories, while autoload files returned as source also leak directory structure; files executed normally by PHP with empty responses and no content leakage must not be counted as source exposure.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步对 composer.json、composer.lock、autoload.php 逐条发起请求；命中判据为 composer.json 返回包含 require 段的 JSON，composer.lock 返回内容哈希与包清单，autoload.php 以源码形式返回。记录每个文件的暴露状态与敏感字段（包版本、仓库地址、绝对路径）；autoload.php 若被正常执行且响应为空，记录为不可判源码泄露而非命中。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, request composer.json, composer.lock, and autoload.php one by one; a hit is composer.json returning JSON with a require section, composer.lock returning content hashes and package inventory, or autoload.php returned as source. Record exposure status and sensitive fields per file (package versions, repository URLs, absolute paths); if autoload.php executed normally with an empty response, log it as indeterminate rather than a source-leak hit.

mitigation.zh: 将 Web 根指向 public 目录而不是项目根目录；通过服务器规则拒绝 composer 文件和 PHP 源码下载；在部署流水线扫描公开路径与镜像层，并将私有仓库凭证迁移到密钥管理。修复后重放第 1 步路径，确认全部不可读且应用正常加载。
mitigation.en: Point the web root at public rather than the project root; block composer files and PHP source downloads via server rules; scan public paths and image layers in the deployment pipeline and move private-repository credentials into secret management. After the fix, replay the step-1 paths and confirm all are unreadable while the application loads normally.

title.zh: 建立 PHP 路径基线

description.zh: 比较不存在的 JSON、lock 和 PHP 文件响应，记录正常执行与源码下载差异。
description.en: Compare responses for nonexistent JSON, lock, and PHP files and record differences between execution and source download.

description.zh: 逐项使用原始文件名检查状态、类型、正文开头和重定向链。
description.en: Use original filenames one at a time and inspect status, type, body prefix, and redirect chain.

analysis.en: Positive evidence is the web service returning an authentic, parseable Gemfile, lockfile, or gemspec that discloses deployed dependencies or internal sources. An HTML fallback with HTTP 200, public repository documentation, empty response, an error page mentioning Gemfile, a directory list showing only a filename, sample project, or unparsable text is a false positive.

name.zh: Ruby Bundler 清单文件探测

description.zh: 检查 Gemfile、Gemfile.lock 和 gemspec 是否被 Web 服务公开并泄露 Ruby 依赖、源地址或内部 gem 信息。
description.en: Checks whether Gemfile, Gemfile.lock, and gemspec files are web-accessible and disclose Ruby dependencies, source URLs, or internal gems.

overview.zh: Ruby Bundler 清单文件探测针对 Gemfile、Gemfile.lock 和 gemspec 被 Web 服务公开的场景：可泄露 Ruby 依赖、源地址或内部 gem 信息。验证三类文件的可达性与 gem 指令内容。
overview.en: Ruby Bundler manifest file discovery targets Gemfile, Gemfile.lock, and gemspec files exposed by the web service, leaking Ruby dependencies, source addresses, or internal gem information. It validates reachability and gem-directive content across the three file classes.

vulnerability.zh: 公开 Gemfile 或锁文件可暴露私有 gem 名称、内部 Git 地址和组件版本，为供应链攻击或组件漏洞枚举提供线索；若响应是 Rails 路由页、错误模板或公开开源项目清单，则不能直接报告生产秘密泄露。
vulnerability.en: Exposed Gemfiles or lockfiles reveal private gem names, internal Git addresses, and component versions, informing supply-chain attacks and component-vulnerability enumeration; responses that are Rails routing pages, error templates, or public open-source inventories must not be reported as production secret leakage.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步对 Gemfile、Gemfile.lock、.gemspec 逐条发起请求；命中判据为 Gemfile 返回包含 gem 指令的内容，锁文件返回依赖解析结构，gemspec 返回 gem 元数据。验证文本结构而非仅看状态码，重点记录 source、git、path、平台与精确版本是否泄露内部开发信息；对照随机路径排除软 404。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, request Gemfile, Gemfile.lock, and .gemspec one by one; a hit is Gemfile returning gem-directive content, lockfiles returning dependency-resolution structures, or gemspecs returning gem metadata. Validate text structure rather than status codes alone, focusing on whether source, git, path, platform, and exact versions leak internal development details; contrast random paths to exclude soft 404s.

mitigation.zh: 只把 Rails public 目录暴露给 Web 服务器；从静态发布物和对象存储排除 Gemfile、锁文件及 gemspec；清理私有源凭据，生成内部 SBOM 并对发布产物做敏感路径检查。修复后重放第 1 步路径，确认全部不可读且应用正常。
mitigation.en: Expose only the Rails public directory to the web server; exclude Gemfiles, lockfiles, and gemspecs from static releases and object storage; clean private-source credentials, generate internal SBOMs, and run sensitive-path checks on release artifacts. After the fix, replay the step-1 paths and confirm all are unreadable while the application works.

prerequisites.en: Confirm project, dependency, plugin, repository, and properties structures with Maven or Gradle parsing rules, defining redaction for credentials and internal URLs.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求 pom.xml 或 Gradle 文件以真实可解析内容公开，并与运行部署的构建坐标/依赖相符；敏感影响需有内部仓库、插件、版本或属性。状态 200、XML 错误页、公开示例、前端 index、空 properties、文件名提示或源码镜像按设计公开都不是部署配置泄露。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires pom.xml or a Gradle file to be publicly returned as authentic, parseable content matching the deployed build coordinates or dependencies; sensitive impact requires internal repositories, plugins, versions, or properties. HTTP 200, an XML error page, public sample, frontend index, empty properties, filename hint, or an intentionally public source mirror is not deployment-configuration exposure.

opsecTips.zh: 首次确认一个真实构建文件后停止，不遍历 target、build、仓库缓存或源码路径。
opsecTips.en: Stop after confirming one authentic build file; do not enumerate target, build, repository caches, or source paths.

opsecTips.zh: 删除下载与解析结果，清理 CDN/服务器缓存和访问日志，轮换测试仓库凭据并修正静态资源白名单。

name.zh: Java Maven 与 Gradle 构建文件探测
name.en: Java Maven and Gradle Build-File Discovery

description.zh: 检查 pom.xml、Gradle 脚本和属性文件是否可公开访问并泄露 Java 依赖、插件或内部仓库配置。
description.en: Checks whether pom.xml, Gradle scripts, and property files are publicly accessible and disclose Java dependencies, plugins, or internal repositories.

overview.zh: Java Maven 与 Gradle 构建文件探测针对 pom.xml、Gradle 脚本和属性文件可公开访问的场景：可泄露 Java 依赖、插件或内部仓库配置。验证四类构建文件的可达性与结构化内容。
overview.en: Java Maven and Gradle build-file discovery targets pom.xml, Gradle scripts, and properties files being publicly accessible, leaking Java dependencies, plugins, or internal repository configuration. It validates reachability and structured content across the four build-file classes.

vulnerability.zh: 生产站点公开构建文件可能泄露组件精确版本、内部仓库、插件任务和构建属性，帮助识别已知漏洞或供应链边界；只看到 XML 页面、Gradle 关键词或公开示例项目不代表当前应用配置泄露。
vulnerability.en: Build files exposed on production sites can reveal exact component versions, internal repositories, plugin tasks, and build properties, aiding known-vulnerability identification and supply-chain mapping; merely seeing XML pages, Gradle keywords, or public sample projects does not prove current application configuration leakage.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步对 pom.xml、build.gradle、settings.gradle、gradle.properties 逐条发起请求；命中判据为 pom.xml 返回包含 project 根元素的 XML，Gradle 文件返回可解析的 dependencies/plugins/repository 结构。区分实际服务清单与文档示例、源码镜像和前端路由回退，记录依赖版本与仓库地址等敏感字段；对照随机路径排除软 404。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, request pom.xml, build.gradle, settings.gradle, and gradle.properties one by one; a hit is pom.xml returning XML with a project root element or Gradle files returning parseable dependencies/plugins/repository structures. Distinguish real service manifests from documentation samples, source mirrors, and SPA-route fallbacks, recording sensitive fields like dependency versions and repository addresses; contrast random paths to exclude soft 404s.

mitigation.zh: 将构建上下文与运行时静态目录完全分离；从 WAR、镜像和 CDN 发布清单中排除构建脚本与仓库配置；对依赖信息使用内部 SBOM 管理，并轮换任何暴露的仓库凭证。修复后重放第 1 步路径，确认全部不可读且业务正常。
mitigation.en: Fully separate build context from runtime static directories; exclude build scripts and repository configuration from WAR, image, and CDN release inventories; manage dependency information via internal SBOMs and rotate any exposed repository credentials. After the fix, replay the step-1 paths and confirm all are unreadable while the business works.

prerequisites.en: Repeatedly collect status, body, close behavior, and timing for controlled final-block byte variants, labeling them with known padding and MAC ground truth.

analysis.zh: 阳性工具证据是 padding 有效与无效类别形成稳定可区分的响应或时延簇，并在重复样本中与测试真值相关。响应含 Invalid padding 字样、一次错误变化、密文长度不同、Base64 解析失败、限流、网络抖动或 MAC 和 padding 统一失败都不能证明 oracle。
analysis.en: Positive tool evidence is padding-valid and padding-invalid classes forming stable distinguishable response or timing clusters correlated with test ground truth across repetitions. Invalid padding text, one changed error, different ciphertext lengths, Base64 parse failure, rate limiting, network jitter, or unified MAC and padding failure does not prove an oracle.

opsecTips.zh: 最小变体集达到预设区分置信度后停止，不进入自适应明文恢复或批量查询。
