name.zh: 对称加密 Padding Oracle 错误签名库

description.zh: 整理填充、解密和 MAC 失败文本用于响应分类；该集合是分析工具输入，不是构造密文的攻击载荷。
description.en: Catalogs padding, decryption, and MAC failure text for response classification; the set is analysis-tool input rather than crafted ciphertext payloads.

overview.zh: 原内容全部是多语言错误字符串，适合对日志和响应进行标签化。真正的 padding oracle 测试需要对同一密文做受控字节变异，并比较状态、正文、连接行为和时序，不能只搜索关键词。
overview.en: The original content is a multilingual error-string catalog suitable for labeling logs and responses. A real padding-oracle test mutates controlled bytes in the same ciphertext and compares status, body, connection behavior, and timing rather than merely searching keywords.

vulnerability.zh: 如果服务对有效填充、无效填充和 MAC 失败给出稳定可区分结果，攻击者可能获得解密或伪造所需的 oracle。日志中存在“Invalid padding”或接口偶发 500，并不能证明远程调用者可观察分支。
vulnerability.en: If valid padding, invalid padding, and MAC failures produce stable distinguishable outcomes, a service may expose an oracle useful for decryption or forgery. An Invalid padding log entry or occasional 500 does not prove that remote callers can observe the branch.

exploitation.zh: 1. 将原始错误文本导入响应与日志聚类工具；2. 使用授权测试密钥对等长密文做单字节受控变异并重复请求；3. 比较状态、长度、时延分布和连接关闭方式。网关错误、负载均衡差异、限流与日志内部可见但客户端不可见均属误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Import original error text into response and log clustering. 2. With an authorized test key, make single-byte controlled mutations to equal-length ciphertexts and repeat requests. 3. Compare status, length, latency distribution, and connection closure. Gateway errors, load-balancer differences, throttling, and server-only log distinctions are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 使用认证加密模式并避免自行组合 CBC 与 MAC；2. 对所有解密失败返回不可区分结果并采用恒定时间处理；3. 在弃用旧密文格式期间加入速率限制、密钥轮换与 oracle 差异回归测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Use authenticated-encryption modes and avoid custom CBC and MAC composition. 2. Return indistinguishable failures with constant-time processing. 3. During legacy-format retirement, add rate limits, key rotation, and regression tests for oracle distinctions.

description.en: Fix endpoint, ciphertext length, and network conditions and define status, body length, timing, and disconnect metrics.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 JWT 签名验证负向测试场景，检验服务端对缺失与异常签名结构的拒绝边界。验证维度为去签名、空签名与空 kid 令牌的提交矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers JWT signature-verification negative testing, testing rejection boundaries for missing and anomalous signature structures. Validation is a submission matrix of stripped, empty and empty-kid tokens, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于解析与验签的执行顺序或失败处理存在缺口：截断签名或空 kid 的令牌落入宽松解析分支，声明在验签前即被采信并进入授权。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is gaps in parse-then-verify ordering or failure handling: truncated-signature and empty-kid tokens fall into lenient parsing branches with claims trusted and authorized before verification.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把去签名、空签名与空 kid 变体逐条提交受保护端点，记录响应与实际主体：任一变体被接受即确认验签缺失，同时以完整签名令牌对照确认解析本身无碍。成功判据以变体接受矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit stripped-signature, empty-signature and empty-kid variants to the protected endpoint one by one per the script, recording responses and effective principals; any variant accepted confirms missing verification, contrasted with fully signed tokens to confirm parsing itself is intact. Judge success by the variant-acceptance matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 验签失败或结构异常一律 401 且日志记录伪造尝试，签名段缺失不进入解析。修复后重放第 1 步矩阵，全部变体应被统一拒绝。
mitigation.en: Return 401 on verification failure or structural anomalies with forgery attempts logged, never parsing tokens missing signature segments. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every variant should be uniformly rejected.

description.en: Verify signature and authorization decisions in server logs, excluding parsing success and client display changes.

description.zh: 签名截断一半，测试实现只校验前 N 字节或长度宽容的场景；成功判据：截断签名令牌仍通过验证。
description.en: Truncates the signature to test prefix-check or length-lenient implementations. Success: the truncated-signature token still validates.

title.zh: 头部变形：非法 base64 签名变体

description.zh: 签名段填非法字符 !!!!，探测异常处理路径是否回退为通过（fail-open）；成功判据：非法签名未导致拒绝。
description.en: Fills the signature with invalid characters to probe whether error handling fails open. Success: the invalid signature does not cause rejection.

description.zh: 头部声明 ES256 而签名填充 64 字节，验证是否只按头部声明做长度校验；成功判据：伪签名通过椭圆曲线校验路径。
description.en: Claims ES256 in the header with 64 filler signature bytes to test header-only length validation. Success: the fake signature passes the EC verification path.

prerequisites.zh: 确认用户输入到达的具体正则、语言引擎和调用路径，在资源受限的独立进程中运行。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the exact regex, language engine, and call path reached by user input, running it in a resource-limited isolated process.

prerequisites.zh: 把固定长度字符串作为初筛后，生成递增长度的失败匹配、成功匹配和随机后缀对照并重复计时。
prerequisites.en: After using fixed-length strings for screening, generate increasing-length failed matches, successful matches, and random-suffix controls and time them repeatedly.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求失败匹配成本随长度可重复地超线性增长，并由 CPU/profile 定位到目标正则；固定样本只能提示候选。一次超时、长度相同输入差异、网络延迟、GC、服务器负载、请求排队、异常处理或安全超时主动终止均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires failed-match cost to grow reproducibly superlinearly with length and CPU profiling to localize it to the target regex; fixed samples only identify candidates. One timeout, differences among equal-length inputs, network latency, garbage collection, server load, request queueing, exception handling, or an active safety timeout is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 曲线首次越过预设 CPU/时延阈值后停止，不发送最大长度或并发请求。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the curve first crosses the predefined CPU or latency threshold; do not send maximum-length or concurrent requests.

opsecTips.zh: 终止隔离进程，清除请求队列、输入和性能 trace，恢复资源限制并替换风险正则。
opsecTips.en: Terminate the isolated process, clear request queues, inputs, and performance traces, restore resource limits, and replace the risky regex.

name.zh: 通用正则表达式拒绝服务输入

description.zh: 使用固定长度的近似失败字符串筛查正则匹配路径，并以可重复的资源增长而非单次超时判定 ReDoS。
description.en: Uses fixed-length near-failing strings to screen regex paths and determines ReDoS from reproducible resource growth rather than a single timeout.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖通用正则拒绝服务基线场景，检验近似失败输入下处理耗时的可重复增长曲线形态。验证维度为固定长度重复字符输入的多轮计时对照矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers a generic regex denial-of-service baseline, testing the repeatable growth-curve shape of processing time under near-match inputs. Validation is a multi-round timing-comparison matrix of fixed-length repeated-character inputs, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于匹配路径存在灾难性回溯结构：重复字符加终止符的输入迫使引擎在宣告失败前穷举全部路径，耗时随长度陡增且可稳定复现。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is catastrophic backtracking in matching paths: repeated characters plus a terminator force the engine through every path before declaring failure, with time spiking by length and reproducing stably.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把同长度重复字符加不同终止符的输入逐条提交目标端点并计时，重复多轮取均值：耗时长于基线且随长度增长即确认 ReDoS 基线，记录每轮数据保证可复现。成功判据以多轮计时一致性为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；控制请求总量避免真实影响。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit inputs of repeated characters with different terminators at fixed lengths to the target endpoint one by one per the script, timing multiple rounds for averages; times above baseline growing with length confirm the ReDoS baseline, recorded per round for reproducibility. Judge success by multi-round timing consistency. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; cap request totals to avoid real impact.

mitigation.zh: 以线性引擎替换高危正则并对输入限制长度，耗时监控关联告警以定位具体接口。修复后重放第 1 步，耗时应与普通输入无显著差异。
mitigation.en: Replace risky regexes with linear engines and cap input lengths, tying timing monitors to alerts pinpointing specific APIs. After the fix, replay step 1: timings should show no significant difference from normal inputs.

description.zh: 采集正常与随机失败输入的正则内部耗时、CPU 和请求端到端延迟。
description.en: Collect internal regex time, CPU, and end-to-end latency for normal and random failed input.

description.zh: 绕过对字面 xxxx 长串的 WAF 签名：\x78、\u0078 与 fromCharCode(120) 在运行期拼出等价 x 串，报文只含转义标记；成功判据：三种构造的回溯耗时与字面输入一致且随长度陡增。
description.en: Bypasses WAF signatures on literal xxxx runs: \x78, \u0078 and fromCharCode(120) assemble the equivalent x-run at runtime so only escape tokens cross the wire; success criterion: all three constructions time like the literal input and climb steeply with length.

wafBypass.command: node -e "const s='x'.repeat(30)+'!'; for (const p of ['(x+)+$','(x|x+)+$','(x*)*$','(x+)*y','(^x)*$']) { const t=Date.now(); new RegExp(p).test(s); console.log(p, Date.now()-t, 'ms'); }"

description.zh: 绕过只识别 (x+)+ 单一写法的防护：(x|x+)+、(x*)*、(x+)*y、(^x)* 等回溯等价形态轮换验证同一输入；成功判据：多个形态计时显著（>100ms）且随输入长度非线性增长。
description.en: Bypasses defenses keyed on the single (x+)+ shape: (x|x+)+, (x*)*, (x+)*y and (^x)* are backtrack-equivalent alternates probed with the same input; success criterion: several shapes time significantly (>100 ms) and grow non-linearly with input length.

description.zh: 绕过对单字符长串（纯 aaaa/xxxx）的长度与熵检测：交替 xy 串对 (x|y)+、(xy)+、(x|y?)+ 类模式同样是灾难输入，签名完全不同；成功判据：交替串触发与纯 x 串同级的回溯耗时。
description.en: Bypasses length/entropy checks on single-char runs: alternating xy strings are equally catastrophic for (x|y)+, (xy)+ and (x|y?)+ style patterns while bearing a totally different signature; success criterion: the alternating run triggers the same magnitude of backtracking as the pure x-run.

title.zh: 表单/JSON 包裹与编码边界

description.zh: 绕过对顶层超长值的拦截：把 x 串放入具名表单字段、JSON 键值或 XML 文本中并在边界用 %21/%2521 编码，应用解码后进入正则；成功判据：包裹形态均产生可测的回溯延迟（对比空串基线）。
description.en: Bypasses interception of top-level oversized values: the x-run is placed inside named form fields, JSON members or XML text with %21/%2521-encoded boundaries, decoded by the app before the regex; success criterion: wrapped forms all produce measurable backtracking delay versus the empty-string baseline.

description.zh: 以固定终止字符和递减长度构造对照输入，用于测量处理时间增长，不包含正则模式定义。
description.en: Build controlled inputs with a fixed terminating character and decreasing lengths to measure processing-time growth without mixing in regex definitions.

prerequisites.zh: 只使用自有测试 HMAC JWT、已知 fixture secret 和离线验证工具，固定 alg、claims 与签名编码。
prerequisites.en: Use only an owned test HMAC JWT, known fixture secret, and offline verification tool, pinning alg, claims, and signature encoding.

prerequisites.zh: 把候选字典与 token/密钥材料保存在临时受限目录，先用正确和错误 fixture 验证工具无误。
prerequisites.en: Keep the candidate wordlist and token or key material in a temporary restricted directory, first validating the tool with correct and incorrect fixtures.

analysis.zh: 阳性工具结果是某个候选离线重算得到与测试 token 完全相同的 HMAC 签名，并由只读测试服务确认该 key 是当前有效 fixture。词在列表中出现、工具只报告可能命中、不同 alg 误用、token 解析成功、网络端点返回 401 或哈希前缀相似都不是弱密钥确认。
analysis.en: Positive tool evidence is a candidate recomputing the exact HMAC signature of the test token offline and the read-only test service confirming that key as the active fixture. A word appearing in the list, a tentative tool hit, algorithm mismatch, token parsing, HTTP 401 from a network endpoint, or a similar hash prefix is not weak-key confirmation.

opsecTips.zh: fixture secret 首次准确命中后停止，不对生产 JWT、在线端点或扩展字典运行。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the fixture secret is first matched exactly; do not run against production JWTs, online endpoints, or expanded dictionaries.

opsecTips.zh: 轮换并删除测试 secret/token，清除字典副本、工具缓存和 shell 历史，并销毁临时目录。
opsecTips.en: Rotate and delete the test secret and token, clear wordlist copies, tool caches, and shell history, and destroy the temporary directory.

name.zh: JWT HMAC 弱密钥审计字典

description.zh: 整理常见 JWT HMAC 密钥候选用于离线授权审计；该字典不应作为独立网络载荷展示。
description.en: Catalogs common JWT HMAC key candidates for authorized offline auditing; the wordlist should not be presented as a standalone network payload.

overview.zh: 原名称损坏且内容实际是常见共享密钥字典。正确流程是获取自有测试令牌后离线验证候选，并确认密钥是否真的能生成服务端接受的签名；不能向接口逐个发送密钥字符串。
overview.en: The original name is corrupted and the content is a common shared-secret wordlist. The proper workflow verifies candidates offline against an owned test token and confirms whether a resulting signature is accepted; secret strings should not be sent directly to endpoints.

vulnerability.zh: HMAC JWT 若使用字典词、默认值或低熵密钥，拥有一个令牌样本的攻击者可能离线恢复密钥并伪造任意声明。工具报告候选命中但无法重算相同签名，或环境实际使用非对称算法时，属于误报。
vulnerability.en: If HMAC JWTs use dictionary words, defaults, or low-entropy secrets, a token sample may permit offline recovery and forged claims. A tool candidate that cannot reproduce the signature, or a deployment using asymmetric algorithms, is a false positive.

exploitation.zh: 1. 确认测试令牌使用受支持的 HMAC 算法并保留原始签名；2. 将原始字典加载到离线 JWT 审计工具，禁止在线尝试；3. 用命中候选重算签名，并仅在隔离环境验证低权限令牌。只有签名一致且服务端接受才成立，解码成功不算证据。
exploitation.en: 1. Confirm that an owned test token uses a supported HMAC algorithm and retain its signature. 2. Load the original wordlist into an offline JWT audit tool with no online attempts. 3. Recompute the signature with any candidate and validate only a low-privilege token in isolation. Confirm only an identical signature accepted by the server; decoding is not evidence.

mitigation.zh: 1. 使用密码学随机、足够长度且独立管理的 HMAC 密钥，或迁移到妥善管理的非对称签名；2. 禁止默认值并定期轮换密钥；3. 在 CI 和密钥管理中检测弱值，同时支持 kid 版本化与旧密钥撤销。
mitigation.en: 1. Use cryptographically random, sufficiently long, independently managed HMAC keys or migrate to properly managed asymmetric signing. 2. Prohibit defaults and rotate keys regularly. 3. Detect weak values in CI and secret management and support kid versioning and old-key revocation.

description.zh: 从自有测试令牌和服务端配置确认使用 HMAC，而不是仅信任未验证的 alg 头。
description.en: Confirm HMAC use from an owned test token and server configuration rather than trusting an unverified alg header.

description.zh: 将原始候选导入 JWT 审计工具，对固定签名执行完全离线的密钥验证。
description.en: Import original candidates into a JWT auditing tool and test against a fixed signature entirely offline.

prerequisites.zh: 固定 secret-scanner 规则版本和上下文过滤，离线统计 precision/recall；如需有效性检查只用专用可撤销测试凭据。
prerequisites.en: Pin secret-scanner rule version and contextual filters and measure precision and recall offline; use only dedicated revocable test credentials for any validity check.

analysis.zh: 阳性工具结果是规则按预期识别标注的 Access Key ID 格式并用上下文把 EXAMPLE 文档串归为测试/低置信，同时能发现完整合成凭据 fixture。仅出现 AKIA 前缀、扫描器报警、没有 Secret Access Key 的文档 ID、公开示例、长度相符或 STS 对无效样例报错都不是云凭据泄露。
analysis.en: Positive tool evidence is the rule recognizing labeled Access Key ID formats while context classifies EXAMPLE documentation strings as test or low confidence, and detecting the complete synthetic credential fixture. An AKIA prefix, scanner alert, documentation ID without a Secret Access Key, public sample, matching length, or STS rejecting an invalid example is not cloud-credential exposure.

opsecTips.zh: 扫描规则达到预设 fixture 指标后停止，不对样例执行 AWS API 调用或扩大到未授权仓库。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the scanner rule reaches the predefined fixture metrics; do not call AWS APIs with samples or expand to unauthorized repositories.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试语料、扫描输出和索引缓存，撤销专用测试凭据，并保留只含聚合指标的报告。
opsecTips.en: Delete test corpora, scan outputs, and index caches, revoke dedicated test credentials, and retain only aggregated metrics in the report.

name.zh: AWS 访问密钥 ID 格式样例
name.en: AWS Access Key ID Format Samples

description.zh: 提供 AWS 访问密钥 ID 外观样例用于密钥扫描规则测试；样例本身不是凭证，也不是攻击载荷。
description.en: Provides AWS access key ID appearance samples for testing secret-scanner rules; the samples are not credentials or attack payloads.

overview.zh: 原集合包含 AWS 文档式示例标识，只有访问密钥 ID 而没有秘密访问密钥。合理用途是测试扫描器能否识别格式并通过上下文、校验和二次验证降低误报，而不是尝试认证。
overview.en: The original set contains documentation-style AWS identifiers with access key IDs but no secret access keys. Its proper use is testing scanner detection and contextual validation to reduce false positives, not attempting authentication.

vulnerability.zh: 真实访问密钥 ID 与对应秘密密钥同时暴露时，可能导致云账号资源被访问；单独的 ID 通常只提供身份线索。字符串以 AKIA 开头、包含 EXAMPLE 或来自测试夹具时，不能报告为有效凭证。
vulnerability.en: A real access key ID exposed with its corresponding secret may permit cloud-resource access; an ID alone generally provides only an identity clue. Strings beginning with AKIA, containing EXAMPLE, or originating from fixtures must not be reported as valid credentials.

exploitation.zh: 1. 将原始样例作为正向格式夹具，并加入随机相似字符串作为负向夹具；2. 在离线仓库副本运行密钥扫描器，不调用 AWS 认证接口；3. 核对文件上下文、配对秘密和测试标记。只有经过资产所有者确认的真实配对凭证才成立，示例值属于误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Use original samples as positive format fixtures and add random lookalikes as negative fixtures. 2. Run secret scanning on an offline repository copy without calling AWS authentication endpoints. 3. Check file context, paired secret material, and test markers. Confirm only real paired credentials verified by the asset owner; examples are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 不在源码、日志或构建产物中存储长期云凭证，优先使用短期角色凭证；2. 部署提交前与服务端密钥扫描，并标注测试夹具；3. 对确认泄露的密钥立即禁用、轮换并审计其使用记录。
mitigation.en: 1. Keep long-lived cloud credentials out of source, logs, and build artifacts and prefer short-lived role credentials. 2. Scan secrets before commit and server-side while marking fixtures. 3. Immediately disable and rotate confirmed leaked keys and audit their use.

description.zh: 把原始 AWS 标识作为扫描器正向样例，并加入不匹配的随机字符串。
description.en: Use original AWS identifiers as positive scanner fixtures and add nonmatching random strings.

description.zh: 将原始样例目录加载到离线扫描工具，验证规则识别与测试标记处理。
description.en: Load the original sample catalog into an offline scanner and verify rule detection and fixture handling.
